items.title: Nasdaq 100 to Enter Third Correction of 2026 as AI Trade Unwinds
items.summary: The Nasdaq 100 is poised to enter correction as investors dump tech stocks on the back of disappointing earnings. Bloomberg's Eric Weiner said that two major questions are at the center of Friday's tech trade selloff: can companies keep spending? And what happens if they can't? Weiner said there isn't a good answer to those questions yet, but the market is predicated on that level of spending continuing. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Ｇ２０外相、集合写真を見送り　欧州やカナダがロシア同席に反発
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [アトランタ ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[アトランタ ３０日 ロイター] - 主要２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）の外相は３０日、米アトランタで開かれた会合を前に、恒例の集合写真の撮影を見送った。欧州の出席者がロシアの同席に反発したことが背景にある。 

米当局者によると、国務省は、集合写真が「見せ物」になったり、会合の妨げになったりすることを望まなかったことから、写真撮影を公式日程から外したという。

西側諸国のある外交官によると、オーストラリアやカナダを含む出席者の３分の１が、ロシアのラブロフ外相との撮影に反対する意向を明確にしたという。 

ドイツのワデフル外相は３０日、会合に先立ち記者団に対し、「欧州のパートナー諸国とラブロフ氏が一緒に写る集合写真は、いかなる場合もあり得ない。ロシアとの関係に正常な状態などないからだ」と述べた。

欧州の当局者は当初、ラブロフ氏を含む写真と含まない写真の２枚を別々に撮影する案を示していたという。

items.title: Codelco despide a ocho ejecutivos y empleados por nuevas irregularidades en sus cifras de producción
items.author: James Attwood
items.summary: La minera estatal chilena tomó la decisión tras detectar nuevos indicios de inconsistencias en la contabilización del cobre. Las investigaciones abarcan tres divisiones y la sede central de Santiago.
items.body: Bloomberg — Codelco despidió a ocho ejecutivos y empleados después de que investigaciones sobre sus cifras de producción hallaran nuevas pruebas de irregularidades, profundizando las consecuencias de un escándalo contable en la gigante chilena del cobre. Los despidos abarcan las divisiones Chuquicamata, Ministro Hales y Salvador, además de la sede central en Santiago, informó el jueves la estatal Codelco. Entre los despedidos figuran el gerente general de Salvador y los gerentes responsables de recursos y desarrollo en las tres divisiones. La reorganización ocurre menos de una semana antes de una junta extraordinaria de accionistas convocada para el 5 de noviembre a solicitud del ministro de Minería, Daniel Mas, y del ministro de Hacienda, Jorge Quiroz, para examinar inconsistencias en las cifras de producción de Codelco de 2024 y 2025. Ver más: Codelco investiga irregularidades que podrían haber inflado su producción de cobre La empresa reveló antes este mes que investigaba indicios de que el mismo cobre podría haber sido contabilizado como producción por más de una división, lo que potencialmente infló la producción reportada por Salvador y Ministro Hales en 2024 y 2025. Codelco entregó esos antecedentes a la fiscalía y contrató a Ernst & Young para investigar el caso, mientras KPMG realiza una revisión más amplia. La Contraloría General de la República también está llevando a cabo una auditoría. Las investigaciones surgieron de una auditoría separada que determinó que unas 27.000 toneladas —cerca del 2% de la producción propia reportada por Codelco el año pasado— habían sido contabilizadas indebidamente como material comercialmente disponible. Ese caso derivó en un despido, otras medidas disciplinarias y el recálculo de incentivos vinculados a la producción. Codelco dijo que no fue necesario modificar sus estados financieros auditados de 2025. Los crecientes problemas en la contabilización de la producción amenazan con erosionar la confianza de clientes y bonistas en Codelco, en momentos en que la minera estatal enfrenta retrasos en proyectos, una menor calidad del mineral, costos crecientes y una deuda en niveles récord. Ver más: Chile permitirá a Codelco retener el 100% de sus ganancias del 2025 para aliviar su deuda El nuevo presidente del directorio, Bernardo Fontaine, y el presidente ejecutivo, Jorge Gómez, están reorientando la estrategia hacia la consolidación de las operaciones y los niveles de producción existentes, con un enfoque que prioriza el valor por sobre el volumen y se aleja de las metas de crecimiento impulsadas por la administración anterior. “La transparencia y la probidad son principios completamente intransables en nuestras empresas públicas”, dijo el ministro Mas en un comunicado en el que respaldó los despidos. Agregó que las medidas forman parte de un esfuerzo por corregir deficiencias y garantizar la confiabilidad de la información corporativa. Codelco dijo que los últimos despidos no impiden que las investigaciones en curso determinen responsabilidades adicionales ni que la empresa emprenda acciones legales. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 

まちまちで取引を終えた。製薬株が買われ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は続伸。月間ベースでは１．１７％高と、３カ月ぶりに上昇した。一方、中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は前日比０．８９％安と反落した。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種製薬・バイオテクノロジー株指数は５．１０％高。製薬大手アストラゼネカは７．０％上昇。組織再編計画の発表が買い材料視された。

一方、銀行株指数は３．１９％安。銀行大手ナットウエストは８．８％下落。金利収入の見通しが予想を下回ったことを受けて、売りが膨らんだ。

金や銅が値下がりしたことを受けて、貴金属株指数は５．２８％、鉱業株指数は２．８６％それぞれ下落した。

石油大手のＢＰは０．５％高。２０２６年７─９月期決算で純利益が過去最高となり、買いが優勢だった。ブリティッシュ・アメリカン・タバコは１．７％、日用品のユニリーバは２．１％それぞれ上昇した。

ヒーリー英財務相は今週、初の予算案を発表。課税の引き上げ幅が懸念された程ではなかったとして関連株が上昇した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

反落して取引を終えた。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は月間ベースでは１．８７％高と、上昇率は今年６月以来の大きさとなった。

米アマゾン・ドット・コムや半導体大手インテルの決算発表を受け、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連インフラ投資を巡る懸念が再燃した。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種テクノロジー株指数は前日比２．７３％下落。フランスの半導体材料大手ソイテックは９．６％、イタリアのテクノプローブは９．０％、それぞれ下落した。

一方、メディア株指数は１．６３％高。直近四半期の決算発表を受けて、音楽大手ユニバーサル・ミュージック・グループ（ＵＭＧ）は７．９％値上がりした。

ドイツの製薬・化学大手バイエルは５．５％高。除草剤の発がん性を巡る３人の女性による訴訟で、バイエル側の主張を支持する判断が下されたことが買い材料視された。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

フランス国債利回りが再び急上昇した。この日発表の指標で、同国経済が予想外に縮小した一方、インフレ率の伸びが加速したことが示された。

フランスの第３・四半期の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）速報値は前期比０．１％減となり、ロイターがまとめたアナリスト予想の０．１％増に反して縮小した。一方、消費者物価指数（ＨＩＣＰ）は前年比３．８％上昇し、２０２３年終盤以来の水準に加速し、予想の３．６％を上回った。

パンテオン・マクロエコノミクスのユーロ圏担当チーフエコノミスト、クラウス・ビステセン氏は「これらの数字は芳しくなく、公的部門のより迅速かつ広範な財政再建を求める圧力を強めるだろう」と述べた。

フランス１０年債利回りは６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の４．９７％。

ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは２ｂｐ上昇の４．５０％。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は１６５ｂｐに拡大した。

イタリア１０年債利回りは横ばいで推移した。

短期金融市場が織り込む欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）による来月の利上げ確率は約９０％。ＥＣＢは２９日、政策金利を予想通り据え置くと決定した。ただ、エネルギー価格の急騰を受けてインフレリスクが高まっていると警告し、１２月の利上げの可能性に含みを残した。

FAST

HOUSTON, Oct 30 : Oil prices jumped more than 2 per cent on Friday and settled at their highest levels since the end of April, as traders braced for a potential escalation in the Iran war after the US midterm elections, with an attack on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz highlighting supply risks.
Brent crude futures for December, which expired on Friday, settled up $2.76, or 2.4 per cent, at $117.64 a barrel, after touching a high of $118. The more active January contract gained $2.63 to $113.43.
US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures settled $2.12, or 2.08 per cent, higher at $104.12.
For the month, Brent finished 13.6 per cent higher, while WTI rose 15.2 per cent.

"Traders will remain focused on oil flows out of the Middle East and the likely escalation by US and allied forces," said Dennis Kissler, senior vice president of trading at BOK Financial. 
On Friday, a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz was hit by explosive devices attached by a small boat, said the UKMTO, the British maritime security service. It was not immediately clear who was behind the attack in the strait, the key sea outlet for Gulf crude and fuel supplies. 
It was the first known successful strike in the waterway using limpet mines, explosives that are attached to a ship's hull from a small boat, since the US-Israeli war with Iran began in February, maritime sources said.
'HIGHER LIKELIHOOD OF AN ESCALATION'
The US ordered non-emergency government employees and their family members to leave Saudi Arabia effective October 23 due to safety risks, the US embassy in Riyadh said on Friday, citing Houthi attacks on civilian airports and other critical infrastructure.
Yemen's Iranian-backed Houthi militants said on Thursday they had attacked several sites in Saudi Arabia, including the large Ras Tanura oil refinery, the Rabigh refinery and a production facility in Abqaiq owned by state oil company Saudi Aramco. 
A Saudi-led coalition also said it had intercepted a cruise missile launched by the Houthis towards the kingdom's western region.
Meanwhile, Qatari mediators returned to Tehran on Friday as part of coordinated efforts to reach a deal between the US and Iran, an official briefed on the talks told Reuters.
US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that Vice President JD Vance had reached out to Iran to help the country get medical supplies, after US media reported Vance had written to Tehran's top security official to revive peace talks.
Iran has received a letter from Vance, but it has not responded to it yet, Iran's semi-official Tasnim news agency reported, adding that Tehran wants the US to meet its conditions and "any position that contradicts this framework is unacceptable."
Oil prices could become even more volatile in the next couple of weeks due to Israel's recent elections and the US midterm elections on November 3, according to a Saxo Bank briefing on Thursday.
The Danish bank said crude is expected to trade in a higher range of $70 to $90 a barrel even after the conflict ends, compared with a pre-war range of $60 to $70.
SAUDI EXPORTS RISE
Saudi Arabia's crude exports rose in October from September, two of three ship-tracking companies said, despite Iranian attacks on shipping in the Gulf and claims by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis of attacks on Saudi oil facilities.
The US oil rig count, an indicator of future output, rose by two. US crude oil output increased in August, while demand for crude oil and petroleum products declined, the US Energy Information Administration (EIA) said in its Petroleum Supply Monthly report on Friday.
Meanwhile, Libya's National Oil Corporation said an armed group shut a valve on Friday on the main Hamada crude oil pipeline, which links the Hamada field to the Zawiya refinery. It said the closure of the valve had halted the flow of about 15,000 barrels per day.

Source: Reuters

items.title: ロシア独立紙「ノーバヤ・ガゼータ」廃刊へ、当局の圧力で
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Andrew Osborn　Nika Khutsieva

[モスクワ ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Andrew Osborn　Nika Khutsieva

[モスクワ ３０日 ロイター] - ロシアの独立系新聞「ノーバヤ・ガゼータ」は３０日、１１月９日に全ての活動を終了すると発表した。当局による一連の圧力により編集幹部が起訴され、資金面の支援や事務所も失ったとしている。

同紙は声明で「われわれは殺された。１１月９日に、３０年間過ごしてきたわが家の明かりを消し、サーバーを停止して立ち去る。新聞はもはや存在しない。ロシア当局と治安機関が、われわれ編集部を活動終了に追い込んだ」と発表した。

同紙は２０２２年にロシア国内で紙媒体の発行を停止したが、モスクワ中心部の事務所を拠点にオンラインでの情報発信を続けていた。

共同創設者で元編集長のドミトリー・ムラトフ氏は「われわれは、戦争と流血に反対する社会の非常に大きな層の利益を代表している。だからこそ、彼らは今、われわれにこうしたことをしている」と語った。

その上で、「戦争で人々が命を落とし、政治犯が亡くなっている時に、われわれは自分たちのために泣いたりしない。ただ荷物をまとめるだけだ」と述べ、最後の号を制作中だと明らかにした。

ムラトフ氏は２１年のノーベル平和賞を共同受賞した。

items.title: Imperial Oil CEO optimistic on progress toward firming up Pathways agreement
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: The chief executive of Imperial Oil Ltd. says he’s encouraged by progress made toward pinning down a final agreement with the federal and Alberta governments to advance the Pathways carbon storage ...
items.body: The chief executive of Imperial Oil Ltd. says he’s encouraged by progress made toward pinning down a final agreement with the federal and Alberta governments to advance the Pathways carbon storage project, which is a condition for the Pacific Link crude pipeline to the West Coast moving ahead. Members of the Oil Sands Alliance, which includes Imperial and four of its peers, reached a non-binding memorandum of understanding with Ottawa and the province in July. They set a Nov. 15 target to finalize binding agreements with each of the companies. “There’s still a lot of work left to do. That’s only a couple of weeks away, but there’s no lack of energy or desire to get to a definitive agreement,” Imperial CEO John Whelan told analysts on a conference call Friday to discuss third-quarter results. “We’re going to make sure we do all the right things that enable us to execute on the definitive agreement. So most importantly is, for me, the shared ambition to make this happen and the work that’s going into that. And I remain really encouraged about where we are.” The Pathways-pipeline quid pro quo was part of a sweeping accord Ottawa and Alberta signed in November 2025 on a wide array of energy matters. The idea is for Pathways to offset some of the carbon dioxide emissions that Pacific Link, recently deemed by Ottawa a project in the national interest, would enable through increased oilsands production. Pathways involves a pipeline network that would carry carbon dioxide captured from various oilsands sites in northern Alberta to an underground storage hub near Cold Lake, Alta. The alliance said that the Pathways Project will have the capacity to transport and store about six million tonnes per year of captured CO2 by the mid-2030s. The parties are aiming for another 10 million tonnes of reductions by 2045. That’s a significant scale-back from the 22 million tonnes of emissions by 2030 they had earlier targeted. In the July Pathways-centred MOU, governments agreed to pursue regulatory and fiscal policies that would spur oilsands growth, which in turn would ensure the pipeline from Alberta to a tanker port in southern British Columbia can be filled. Ottawa agreed to extending investment tax credits for certain carbon-capture equipment, while Alberta has agreed to “financial supports” to encourage oilsands growth, alluding recently to potential royalty incentives. The other Oil Sands Alliance members are Suncor Energy, Canadian Natural Resources, Cenovus Energy and ConocoPhillips. Earlier Friday, Imperial reported a third-quarter profit of $2.45 billion, up from $539 million in the same quarter last year, boosted by higher oil prices. The profit amounted to $5.11 per diluted share for the quarter compared with a profit of $1.07 per diluted share a year ago. Total revenue and other income amounted to $16.21 billion, up from $12.05 billion in the same quarter last year. Upstream production averaged 418,000 gross oil-equivalent barrels per day, down from 462,000 a year ago, primarily due to lower production at Kearl and planned maintenance turnarounds at Cold Lake and Syncrude. Production in the oilsands was crimped by a third-party pipeline outage caused by an electrical transformer failure in mid-September, Whelan said. “We don’t see systemic issues. We see one-offs that we’re going to learn from,” he said. “We see nothing in the underlying performance that causes us any doubt whatsoever on our future targets.” Refinery throughput averaged 381,000 barrels per day, down from 425,000 in the third quarter of 2025 as capacity utilization dropped to 88 per cent, compared with 98 per cent in the third quarter of 2025. Imperial says it faced unplanned downtime, also due to a third-party pipeline outage. The price of West Texas Intermediate, the U.S. light oil benchmark, averaged US$85.68 during the third quarter, up from US$64.97 during the same period a year earlier. Western Canada Select, the price of heavy crude produced in Alberta, rose to US$71.90 from US$54.62 year-over-year during the quarter. In recent weeks the price gap between WTI and WCS has reportedly widened by as much as US$30, where normally it would be less than half that. Even so, Whelan said the market conditions are favourable for heavy oil producers like Imperial, which can make money and pay dividends at a price much lower than it is currently. “The absolute price of WCS remains extremely constructive.” This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 30, 2026. By Lauren Krugel

items.author: CNA

"Traders will remain focused on oil flows out of the Middle East and the likely escalation by US and allied forces," said Dennis Kissler, senior vice president of trading at BOK Financial.

HOUSTON: Oil prices rose on Friday (Oct 30) to their highest levels since the end of April, putting them on track for a fourth straight month of gain s, as traders braced for a potential escalation in the Iran war after the US midterm elections, with an attack on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz highlighting supply risks .
Brent crude futures for December LCOc1, which expire on Friday, were up US$2.287, or 2.5 per cent, at US$117.75 a barrel as of 1:07pm EDT, after touching a high of US$118. The more active January contract LCOc2 gained US$3.23 to $114.03.
US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures CLc1 climbed US$2.74, or 2.7 per cent, to US$104.79.
For the month, Brent was on course to finish 13 per cent higher, while WTI was heading for a 15 per cent jump.

"Traders will remain focused on oil flows out of the Middle East and the likely escalation by US a nd allied forces," said Dennis Kissler, senior vice president of trading at BOK Financial.
On Friday, a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz - the key sea outlet for Gulf crude and fuel supplies - was hit by explosive devices attached by a small boat, s aid the UKMTO, the British maritime security service . It was not immediately clear who was behind the attack .
It was the first known successful strike using limpet mines, explosives that are attached to a ship's hull f rom a small boat, in the waterway since the US- Israeli war with Iran began in February, maritime sources said.
"Continued kinetic action around the Strait of Hormuz amidst doubts of a viable diplomatic pathway is keeping oil prices elevated in expectation of an escalation of the conflict in coming weeks," said Saul Kavonic, head of energy research at MST Marquee.
Meanwhile, Libya's National Oil Corporation said an armed group shut a valve on Friday on the main Hamada crude oil pipeline, which links the Hamada field to the Zawiya refinery. It said the closure of the valve had halted the flow of about 15,000 barrels per day.

Related:

Iran says four tankers on fire after hitting mines in Strait of Hormuz

Rubio hosts G20 ministers as Iran, Ukraine wars divide members

"HIGHER LIKELIHOOD OF AN ESCALATION" Qatari mediators returned to Tehran on Friday as part of coordinated efforts to reach a deal between the US and Iran, an official briefed on the talks told Reuters.
Still, Yemen's Iranian-backed Houthi militants said on Thursday they had attack ed several sites in Saudi Arabia, including the large Ras Tanura oil refinery, the Rabigh refinery and a production facility in Abqaiq owned by state oil company Saudi Aramco.
A Saudi-led coalition also said it had intercepted a cruise missile launched by the Houthis towards the kingdom's western region. Saudi Arabia's crude exports have risen in October compared with September, two of three ship-tracking companies said, despite Iranian attacks on shipping in the Gulf and claims by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis of attacks on Saudi oil facilities.
US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that Vice President JD Vance had reached out to Iran to help the country get medical supplies, after US media reported Vance had written to Tehran's top security official to revive peace talks.
Iran has received a letter from Vance, but it has not responded to it yet, Iran's semi -official Tasnim news agency reported, adding that Tehran wants the US to meet its conditions and "any position that contradicts this framework is unacceptable."
Oil prices could become even more volatile in the next couple of weeks due to Israel's recent elections and the US midterm e lections on Nov 3 , according to a Saxo Bank briefing in Singapore on Thursday.
The Danish bank said heightened uncertainty mak es it difficult to forecast prices, but added that crude is expected to trade in a higher range of US$70 to US$90 a barrel even after the conflict ends , compared with a pre-war r ange of US$60 to US$70.
The US oil rig count, an indicator of future output, rose by two. US crude oil output increased in August, while demand for crude oil and petroleum products declined, the US Energy Information Administration (EIA) said in its Petroleum Supply Monthly report on Friday.

Related:

Rising costs, healthcare and foreign policy weigh on US voters ahead of midterm elections

Analysis: As Iran war drags on, airlines pull back on fuel hedges and warn on fares

Source: Reuters/fs

items.title: DOJ Seeks Grand Jury Indictment of Comey in Defense Secrets Case
items.author: list.metadata.agency
items.summary: The Justice Department is actively working to secure a grand jury indictment against former FBI Director James Comey for allegedly directing the sharing of secret national defense information, a federal prosecutor said in court Friday.
items.body: (Bloomberg) -- The Justice Department is actively working to secure a grand jury indictment against former FBI Director James Comey for allegedly directing the sharing of secret national defense information, a federal prosecutor said in court Friday.“We are still going to the grand jury very diligently,” Special Assistant US Attorney Dustin Farahnak said in a hearing at the US District Court for the District of Columbia. The proceeding focused on Comey’s motion to toss a criminal information — a charging document — filed in Washington on the eve the statute of limitations was set to expire.Comey, a frequent DOJ target under the second Trump administration, is accused of being involved in the communication of classified information to the New York Times in October 2016. DOJ said it filed the charging document “to toll the statute of limitations” as it relates to the allegations.Comey’s attorneys argue the criminal information is untimely and that the statute requires an indictment be filed within the 10 years.Farahnak told Judge Trevor McFadden that the grand jury process is still playing out, and that DOJ has evidence showing potential additional actions that would fall within the statute of limitations, including as recently as April 2017.DOJ is attempting to keep the prosecution alive as Comey’s attorneys push for McFadden to not wait for an indictment to toss the case. Ephraim McDowell of Cooley LLP noted in court Friday that FBI agents have been spotted outside his house.There shouldn’t be an arrest “threat hanging over Mr. Comey’s head,” McDowell said.The case is USA v. Comey, D.D.C., No. 1:26-cr-00229, 10/30/26.To contact the reporter on this story: Celine Castronuovo in Washington at ccastronuovo@bloombergindustry.comTo contact the editor responsible for this story: Ellen M. items.title: ＦＲＢ、追加利上げ少なくとも2回必要＝ダラス連銀総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Ann Saphir

[３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Ann Saphir

[３０日 ロイター] - 米ダラス地区連銀のローガン総裁は３０日、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）がインフレを抑制するには少なくともあと２回の利上げが必要だとの認識を示した。これは、ウォーシュ議長が５月に就任して以降、米中銀当局者が示した金利指針の中でも最も明確なものの一つだ。

ローガン氏は、ノースカロライナ州デビッドソン大学の学生に向けて準備した講演原稿で「現在の見通しを踏まえると、米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）が少なくともあと２回、０．２５％ポイントの利上げを実施する必要があることは明確だ」と表明。その上で「その後は、追加の措置が適切かどうかを判断するために、経済・金融情勢を見極める一時停止が理にかなっていると考える」とした。

ローガン氏は今週のＦＯＭＣで、短期金利を現行の３．７５─４．００％のレンジに据え置く決定に賛成票を投じた。決定は１０対２だった。ローガン氏はＦＲＢ政策当局者の中でもタカ派寄りに位置する。

さらにローガン氏は「技術分野の投資見通しや地政学的な動向を巡るニュースを受け、金融市場は不安定な状態が続いている」と指摘。「こうした環境では、政策をより緩やかに調整することで、家計や企業、市場参加者が高い金利に適応しやすくなり、経済活動が必要以上に急激に悪化するリスクを軽減できる」と述べた。

ただしＦＲＢが政策の最終到達点を明確にすることが重要だとも述べた。これは、そうした指針は危機時にのみ示すべきだとするウォーシュ議長の主張とは対照的な見解となる。

長期金利については、最近の上昇はより力強い成長とより高い金利への期待を反映したものだと分析。「市場金利の上昇は、経済活動に対する独立した逆風というよりも、金融政策にはまだやるべきことがあると投資家が考えていることを示すメッセージだ」と語った。今週のＦＯＭＣでの政策据え置きはＦＲＢの最終到達点を変えるものではないとも述べ、「市場参加者がＦＯＭＣの政策方針を理解している限り、各利上げの正確なタイミングは、大半の借り手が支払う長期金利にほとんど影響を与えない」と述べた。

items.title: Banco central colombiano no sorprendió al mercado: mantuvo tasas en 12,25%
items.author: Daniel Guerrero
items.summary: La decisión fue por mayoría y dejó la puerta abierta a nuevos incrementos de tasas en la última sesión de política monetaria del 2026 que se realizará en diciembre.
items.body: Bogotá — La Junta Directiva del Banco de la República acaba de decidir mantener las tasas de interés en el 12,25%, tal como lo esperaba el mercado financiero. La decisión de la Junta del Emisor fue tomada por mayoría. En la reunión anterior la decisión había sido tomada por una mayoría de cuatro directores. La Junta Directiva del banco central colombiano no se reunirá en noviembre, pero volverá a tomar decisiones de política monetaria en la sesión de diciembre. Miguel Gómez Martínez, ministro de Hacienda, no participó de la rueda de prensa de política monetaria. ayer radicó una ambiciosa reforma tributaria para ajustar las finanzas públicas. Para la decisión se tuve en cuenta que la inflación anual en septiembre repuntó levemente y se ubicó en 6,3%, ligeramente por debajo de lo esperado por el mercado. La inflación básica sin alimentos ni regulados se redujo, al pasar de 6,1% en agosto a 6,0% en septiembre. El Fenómeno de El Niño constituye un riesgo al alza importante para las sendas de alimentos y regulados Las expectativas de inflación de los analistas económicos para diciembre de 2026 aumentaron levemente a 6,9% y para un horizonte de dos años permanecieron alrededor de 4,0%. Las expectativas implícitas en el mercado de deuda pública aumentaron en el corto plazo y continúan alejadas de la meta del 3% en todos los horizontes. El crecimiento anual de la economía colombiana se habría desacelerado en el tercer trimestre frente al observado en el trimestre anterior. Así lo sugieren los indicadores de la demanda interna que apuntan a un menor crecimiento del consumo, tanto en sus componentes privado como público. Asimismo, el ISE de agosto y las encuestas de industria manufacturera y de comercio al por menor señalan un bajo desempeño de los sectores productivos La evolución de las finanzas públicas es un factor de primer orden en el desempeño macroeconómico futuro y en los esfuerzos de la política monetaria por conducir la inflación a su meta. En este sentido, la Junta Directiva manifiesta la importancia del estudio riguroso del Proyecto de Ley de Rescate Económico radicado ayer en el Congreso.

MEXICO CITY, Oct 30 : Formula One champion Lando Norris has a simple view of racing: If a teammate beats him then it means he needs to do a better job.
The McLaren driver says also that he always blames himself first, never his equipment.
"I don't know what else I'm going to say," the Briton said ahead of a Mexico City Grand Prix that is set to see Mercedes' Italian Kimi Antonelli succeed him as world champion and become the youngest driver, at 20, to take the title.
Antonelli has eclipsed his own teammate George Russell with nine wins to three and is 123 points clear of the more experienced Briton, who has had an erratic season of highs and lows.

Mercedes have said the current car does not suit Russell's style while the 28-year-old says he is still searching for answers.
NOT DONE A GOOD ENOUGH JOB
"If my teammate beats me in a car, I've not done a good enough job," said Norris, last year's winner in Mexico City, when asked about the Mercedes situation, setting out his own philosophy.
"I've never blamed my equipment. I always look at myself first, I always blame myself first."
Norris said he and teammate Oscar Piastri, who is 67 points behind him in the standings, had found the car difficult to drive in Texas last weekend, but he still blamed himself for not putting together a perfect lap in the final phase of qualifying.
"Even though some of it's not my fault because the car was so tricky, I still don't say the only reason I'm not P2 is because the car was tricky. I say because I didn't do a perfect job," he explained.
"I can't stand losing to whoever ... so I will have to do whatever I can to be better ... even if the car suits Oscar more than me, I've got to change. I don't know what else you're meant to do. That's my job as a driver."
"You need to learn how to adapt to different situations. And I can't speak for the others. Whatever they say is what they say ... the only excuse I would have if I got beat by my teammate is that I've not done a good enough job and the excuse can't be it (the car) doesn't suit me."
Norris said that flexibility had been the key to his own success last season, having to adapt when Piastri appeared to be romping away with the title.
"I had to change what I was comfy doing. I had to change my expectation, what felt good versus what didn't feel good ... it's not 'my way should be the way'," added Norris.
"It's always like - OK, it's a new car. How do I get the most out of it. I've always thought of it that way, not 'my driving style is the best driving style, why is it not doing what I want?'"
Russell said on Thursday that there were a "few factors with the cars this year that potentially favour or hinder a certain driving style".
He explained that he had always been on the throttle earlier than most on the exit to corners, which was not the most efficient way to drive with the new power units, and higher tyre pressures had also had an impact.
"This season I haven't lost it overnight," said Russell. "It's just the hit rate. It's like a baseball player, like hitting a home run or you're missing the ball."

Source: Reuters

China's GJ-21 stealth drone has completed its first takeoff and landing on the Sichuan, marking what state media called "a breakthrough in China's amphibious assault ship programme"

BEIJING: China 's first carrier-based stealth reconnaissance and strike drone , the GJ-21, recently completed its first takeoff and landing on the Sichuan, the country's first Type 076 amphibious assault ship, state news agency Xinhua reported on Friday (Oct 30).
The trial underscores Beijing's push to integrate drone technology into its military modernisation drive, a decades-long effort in which China has developed advanced warships, fighter jets, missiles and increasingly capable unmanned systems.
Xinhua hailed the test as "a breakthrough in China 's amphibious assault ship programme" and said it signifies the navy's ability to operate fixed-wing stealth drone s from large naval platforms.
GJ-21 first appeared at a military parade Beijing held last year to mark the 80th anniversary of the end of World War Two, where it displayed different types of weapons.

State tabloid the Global Times reported on Friday that GJ-21 has a substantial combat radius despite having a smaller airframe than the stealth y J-35 and J-20 fighters, citing military expert Zhang Xuefeng.
"GJ-21 is also low cost and reusable. Unlike hypersonic missiles, it can be recovered and redeployed multiple times. It can also deploy small, low-cost glide-guided bombs. Under high-tempo operations, it offers greater fire delivery efficiency with better cost control," Zhang was quoted as saying.

Related:

The Sichuan, the lead vessel of China 's Type 076 amphibious assault ship class, was launched in December 2024 and features electromagnetic catapult and arresting technology. It can carry fixed-wing drone s, helicopters and amphibious equipment.
The vessel has a full-load displacement of more than 40,000 metric tons and features a full-length flight deck and twin-island superstructure.
China 's state television CCTV said on Friday that the indigenously developed vessel conducted consecutive sea trials in late October. It did not disclose locations of the trials.
China 's navy said in April that the Sichuan sailed to waters in the South China Sea for scientific testing and training missions. It said at the time the deployment was a routine test and did not aim at any specific target.

Source: Reuters/fs

State tabloid the Global Times reported on Friday that GJ-21 has a substantial combat radius despite having a smaller airframe than the stealth y J-35 and J-20 fighters, citing military expert Zhang Xuefeng.
"GJ-21 is also low cost and reusable. Unlike hypersonic missiles, it can be recovered and redeployed multiple times. It can also deploy small, low-cost glide-guided bombs. Under high-tempo operations, it offers greater fire delivery efficiency with better cost control," Zhang was quoted as saying.

The Sichuan, the lead vessel of China 's Type 076 amphibious assault ship class, was launched in December 2024 and features electromagnetic catapult and arresting technology. It can carry fixed-wing drone s, helicopters and amphibious equipment.
The vessel has a full-load displacement of more than 40,000 metric tons and features a full-length flight deck and twin-island superstructure.
China 's state television CCTV said on Friday that the indigenously developed vessel conducted consecutive sea trials in late October. It did not disclose locations of the trials.
China 's navy said in April that the Sichuan sailed to waters in the South China Sea for scientific testing and training missions. It said at the time the deployment was a routine test and did not aim at any specific target.

items.title: 米追加利上げ「近く」必要、インフレ高止まり＝セントルイス連銀総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Michael S. Derby

[３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Michael S. Derby

[３０日 ロイター] - 米セントルイス地区連銀のムサレム総裁は３０日、高止まりするインフレに対応するため、近く利上げが必要だとの認識を示した。

ムサレム総裁は、「シャドー・オープン・マーケット・コミッティー」での講演原稿で、「追加的な金融引き締めが必要であり、それも早急に必要になると判断している」と述べた。

また、「後になって大規模かつ急激な対応を取るよりも、早期に段階的な調整を行う方が通常は混乱が少ない」とし、「インフレ期待が安定している間に、より早い段階で小幅な措置を講じる方が、労働市場や経済成長に悪影響を及ぼすことなく成功する可能性が高い」と語った。

ムサレム氏は、インフレ率が２％目標に比べて依然高過ぎ、上振れリスクが続いていると指摘。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が行動を起こさなければ、インフレが緩和される可能性は低いとの見方を示した。その上で、金融政策は現時点でインフレを押し下げられる状況にないとし、「金融政策と金融環境は依然として緩和的だと考える。金融環境は最近、引き締まった」と述べた。 

さらにムサレム氏は講演後、現在の重点課題の一つは、高い物価上昇圧力が経済全体に波及しないようにすることだと説明。「私が現在、特に注力しているのは、インフレのさらなる拡大や、インフレの二次的影響を抑えることだ」と述べ、「住宅を除いたサービス部門のインフレ、コア・サービス・インフレに注目しており、これらの分野における物価上昇圧力が悪化しないよう注視している」と述べた。

ムサレム氏は今年、連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）の投票権を持たないが、来年には投票権を得る。

items.title: Cyber Monday: casi 800 marcas participarán y el mercado pone a prueba el consumo
items.author: Belén Escobar
items.summary: La nueva edición del evento virtual llega después de un Hot Sale que no logró superar en facturación a la inflación en términos reales. Las claves para aprovechar ofertas y descuentos.
items.body: Buenos Aires — El Cyber Monday tendrá en esta edición cerca de 800 marcas participantes, en un escenario en el que el comercio electrónico buscará impulsar las ventas y sostener su dinamismo frente a un consumo que sigue condicionado por el poder adquisitivo de los hogares en Argentina . El evento organizado por la Cámara Argentina de Comercio Electrónico (CACE) se realizará este lunes 2 hasta el miércoles 4 de noviembre y ofrecerá alrededor de 15.000 ofertas en diez categorías de productos y servicios. Esta nueva edición llega después de un Hot Sale que, pese al crecimiento de las ventas nominales, no logró superar en facturación a la inflación en términos reales, al ubicarse en ARS$673.000 millones, con un avance menor al 20%. En ese contexto, las promociones, cuotas y herramientas para comparar precios vuelven a ocupar un lugar central en la estrategia de los comercios para atraer compradores. El comercio electrónico, además, profundiza su alcance. Según el Estudio Mid Term 2026 de la CACE, el 16% de los argentinos realizó su primera compra digital durante este año, una señal de que el canal online todavía incorpora nuevos consumidores. Serán en torno a 800 marcas las que se suman a la participación del Cyber Monday este año. El sitio oficial del evento reunirá promociones en diez categorías: Electro y Tecno; Viajes; Bebés y Niños; Salud y Belleza; Deportes y Fitness; Indumentaria y Calzado; Muebles, Hogar y Deco; Super, Bodegas y Gastronomía; Motos y Autos; y Servicios y Varios. Según CACE, la participación de las pequeñas y medianas empresas también será relevante: el 47% de las compañías que forman parte del evento son pymes. Para estas firmas, la iniciativa representa una oportunidad de ganar visibilidad y captar clientes en un canal en el que compiten con grandes marcas. VER MÁS: El sueldo no alcanza en Argentina: vivienda y alimentos suben más que la inflación y obligan a recortar gastos La logística y las opciones de financiamiento aparecen entre los factores que pueden inclinar la decisión de compra. Las entregas rápidas, las cuotas y las políticas de devolución son herramientas con las que los comercios buscan diferenciarse y facilitar las operaciones. Entre las propuestas previstas figuran las secciones MegaOfertas, Descolocados, Historias, MegaOfertas Top, MegaOfertas Bomba, Noche Bomba y Mega BOOM. También habrá un ranking de los productos más clickeados y filtros para ordenar los resultados por precio, consultar cuotas sin interés, identificar descuentos por volumen —como 2x1 y 3x2— y seleccionar talles o colores. Otra de las novedades será Cybot, un asistente conversacional desarrollado con inteligencia artificial que ayudará a los usuarios a buscar productos y marcas y ofrecerá recomendaciones dentro de la plataforma. El sitio también contará con un buscador de beneficios bancarios para facilitar la identificación de promociones asociadas a medios de pago. VER MÁS: ¿Carne cara o barata? Cómo está el precio por kilo en Argentina frente a otros países de la región En tanto, según un informe de Netquest/Bilendi, uno de cada cuatro argentinos usa la Inteligencia Artificial para compras y decisiones de consumo, por lo que el evento virtual llegará en un contexto en el que los usuarios son más exigentes y buscan con más precisión los productos en los que tienen interés. Desde Tiendanube puntualizaron que, para encontrar las mejores ofertas, hay ciertas acciones y herramientas disponibles para los consumidores. Para los comercios, el Cyber Monday representa una oportunidad de concentrar operaciones y atraer compradores en un período acotado. Sin embargo, el desempeño del evento no dependerá únicamente de la cantidad de ofertas o del crecimiento de la facturación nominal, sino también de la capacidad de los descuentos para impulsar compras efectivas en un contexto de restricciones presupuestarias. Para los consumidores, comparar precios entre comercios, revisar las condiciones de financiación y verificar los costos de envío será clave para determinar si las promociones representan un ahorro efectivo. VER MÁS: Semáforo del consumo en Argentina: más de la mitad de los indicadores sigue en rojo pese a mejoras

Oct 30 : Alliant Energy expects to sign contracts for about 1 gigawatt of additional data-center demand within six months, its finance chief said on Friday, as rising AI use and growing electrification push US power demand to record highs.
The new load would add to the 3.4 GW that Alliant has already contracted with Alphabet's Google, Meta Platforms and Blackstone-backed QTS Data Centers.
Earnings growth could exceed the company's 8 per cent target if capital spending rises further to support future load growth and other investment opportunities, Chief Financial Officer Robert Durian said on a post-earnings call.
"We continue to work on what I'll call capital upside for different opportunities, including the additional load growth that we may see from the data center prospects that we have," Durian said.

US electricity consumption hit an all-time high in 2025 and is expected to continue rising this year and the next as data-center capacity expands with rapid AI adoption, alongside growing electrification, according to the US Energy Information Administration.
The additional 1 GW is expected to begin ramping up between 2029 and 2031, with related investments spread across the company's current planning horizon and beyond, Durian said.
Alliant also expects Meta to begin taking transmission service in Wisconsin in the first quarter of 2027, marking an early step in its expanding pipeline of large-load developments.
On Thursday, the Madison, Wisconsin-based utility raised its four-year capital expenditure forecast by 19 per cent to $15.9 billion between 2027 and 2030, with peak demand across its system expected to increase by more than 60 per cent by 2031.
It also narrowed its 2026 earnings outlook to the upper half of its prior range and issued 2027 guidance of $3.63 to $3.73 per share. The midpoint was in line with Wall Street expectations, according to data compiled by LSEG.
Alliant Energy serves roughly 1 million electric and 427,000 natural gas customers across Iowa and Wisconsin.

Source: Reuters

US SEC's top cop says agency is monitoring AI corporate disclosures

NEW YORK, Oct 30 : The US Securities and Exchange Commission is examining artificial intelligence companies' corporate disclosures as investor worries mount over a potential AI bubble that may have been fueled by circular deals, the agency's enforcement director told Reuters on Friday. 
Big Tech stocks sold off this week as companies disclosed they are burning through cash to fuel their AI expansion at a time when interest rates are rising, raising questions about the sustainability of AI spending.
David Woodcock, who became SEC enforcement director in May, said the agency does not want to stand in the way of tech innovation, but that it is the agency's job to ensure issuers are giving investors the full picture on potential risks. 
"Our principal concern is that people are making accurate disclosures about material information so that investors know what they're getting into," Woodcock said in an interview. "Enforcement is a very necessary piece of making sure people are doing that."

Where such disclosure does not happen, "then enforcement will be present," he said.
Woodcock also said that AI and superintelligence have made scams much easier and cheaper to manufacture at scale, raising risks for more and more people. Brokers and other firms need to have processes in place to protect retail investors and "take thoughtful action," he said.
PRIVATE MARKETS AND PREDICTION MARKETS
Woodcock said the SEC will continue to look at issues in private markets, adding that the enforcement team's asset management unit is very focused on conflicts of interest and valuations.
"When people don't make accurate disclosures, whether it's about valuations or whatever, then there is a role for enforcement," Woodcock said. "I think you'll see more activity in this space."
Reuters previously reported the SEC was probing a type of private equity fund as part of the agency's broader interest in the opaque markets. 
Woodcock said the SEC also has a role in overseeing prediction markets, which allow people to bet on real-world events, including sports, government policy announcements and elections.
The markets, led by Polymarket and Kalshi, have surged in popularity over the past two years and have been pushing into US stocks. Such equity-linked prediction markets would traditionally fall under SEC jurisdiction. 
Woodcock said the agency's enforcement staff are working with policy officials as well as the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, which broadly oversees swap markets, to monitor and regulate the booming new markets.
When asked about the possibility of bringing cases against firms that do not register with the agency, Woodcock said the agency does not want to regulate the new industry through enforcement actions. 
"We want to be involved where it makes sense, but not in a way that crushes innovation," he said.

Source: Reuters

US SEC's top cop says agency is monitoring AI corporate disclosures

NEW YORK, Oct 30 : The US Securities and Exchange Commission is examining artificial intelligence companies' corporate disclosures as investor worries mount over a potential AI bubble that may have been fueled by circular deals, the agency's enforcement director told Reuters on Friday. 
Big Tech stocks sold off this week as companies disclosed they are burning through cash to fuel their AI expansion at a time when interest rates are rising, raising questions about the sustainability of AI spending.
David Woodcock, who became SEC enforcement director in May, said the agency does not want to stand in the way of tech innovation, but that it is the agency's job to ensure issuers are giving investors the full picture on potential risks. 
"Our principal concern is that people are making accurate disclosures about material information so that investors know what they're getting into," Woodcock said in an interview. "Enforcement is a very necessary piece of making sure people are doing that."

Where such disclosure does not happen, "then enforcement will be present," he said.
Woodcock also said that AI and superintelligence have made scams much easier and cheaper to manufacture at scale, raising risks for more and more people. Brokers and other firms need to have processes in place to protect retail investors and "take thoughtful action," he said.
PRIVATE MARKETS AND PREDICTION MARKETS
Woodcock said the SEC will continue to look at issues in private markets, adding that the enforcement team's asset management unit is very focused on conflicts of interest and valuations.
"When people don't make accurate disclosures, whether it's about valuations or whatever, then there is a role for enforcement," Woodcock said. "I think you'll see more activity in this space."
Reuters previously reported the SEC was probing a type of private equity fund as part of the agency's broader interest in the opaque markets. 
Woodcock said the SEC also has a role in overseeing prediction markets, which allow people to bet on real-world events, including sports, government policy announcements and elections.
The markets, led by Polymarket and Kalshi, have surged in popularity over the past two years and have been pushing into US stocks. Such equity-linked prediction markets would traditionally fall under SEC jurisdiction. 
Woodcock said the agency's enforcement staff are working with policy officials as well as the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, which broadly oversees swap markets, to monitor and regulate the booming new markets.
When asked about the possibility of bringing cases against firms that do not register with the agency, Woodcock said the agency does not want to regulate the new industry through enforcement actions. 
"We want to be involved where it makes sense, but not in a way that crushes innovation," he said.

Source: Reuters

items.title: ‘Nice balancing point’: TMX CEO on the firm’s diversification efforts
items.author: Jordan Fleguel
items.summary: The head of Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX) operator TMX Group Ltd. says the company has continued to diversify its global business offerings as it leans into data services and subscription models that ...
items.body: The head of Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX) operator TMX Group Ltd. says the company has continued to diversify its global business offerings as it leans into data services and subscription models that provide recurring revenue and stability. TMX CEO John McKenzie told BNN Bloomberg on Friday that the exchange operator has identified three strategic measures that make up its long-term diversification strategy. “One is around the global distribution, so we are now half of the business outside of Canada, half inside, and that’s a real nice balancing point for us,” he said. “It gives us access to the world, access to global investors, but it doesn’t reduce the prominence and importance of what we do in the Canadian market.” The second focus area, McKenzie said, involves its recurring revenue model, driven by the firm’s financial services that are subscription oriented. He said the company now brings in over 50 per cent of its revenue from subscriptions. “That gives investors a lot of confidence in the stability of the long-term growth of the organization, as opposed to what can happen on a cyclical basis,” said McKenzie. “But the last piece is around the real global insights in the data space… that’s now over 40 per cent of the franchise, and our objective is for that to be 50 per cent of the franchise, because it gives the organization way better balance.” TMX Group’s Q3 earnings TMX’s diversification strategy has been paying off for investors, McKenzie argued. His comments came a day after the company reported third quarter earnings that showed revenue grew by 17 per cent year-over-year. The firm reported adjusted diluted earnings per share of $0.63, up 21 per cent from the same quarter in 2025. “Organic revenue increased 11 per cent year-over-year, highlighted by double-digit growth in revenue from TMX VettaFi, Derivatives Trading and Clearing, and Capital Formation,” David Arnold, TMX’s chief financial officer, said in the company’s earnings release. “In addition to impressive business performance and excellent results, we advanced our long-term growth strategy by completing the acquisitions of Cboe Australia and RAFI Indices, funded with cash and debt. Our balance sheet is strong, and we remain agile in our investment approach.” McKenzie noted that those acquisitions led to a decrease in year-over-year net income in the quarter, but the transactions are designed to be “immediately accretive” for TMX investors. “Every acquisition we’ve done has been designed not just to create value for the shareholders, but also to create value for the Canadian ecosystem too,” he said. TMX has tapped debt markets in recent months to cover its acquisition costs. In September, it closed a $1.1 billion Canadian private placement debenture offering, and the company still has two acquisitions yet to close, McKenzie said. “But even when we get all this done, our total leverage in the organization… would be kind of about 3.2 times, which is a range we’ve been in before,” he said. “We’ve got a really good track record on pay down to get back to our target range of one and a half to two and a half (times), so it gives us the capabilities of continuing to deploy capital strategically if the right opportunity presents itself that helps to accelerate our strategy.” Listing challenges TMX Group’s focus on diversification comes at a time when fewer companies are being listed on Canada’s main stock exchange. The Canadian Press reported on Tuesday that during the first nine months of this year, there were 337 new listings on the TSX and its junior venture exchange, according to TMX’s September market intelligence report. Of those, only 101 were companies, with the others being investment products like exchange-traded funds (ETFs). During the same period five years ago, the number of total listings was comparable at 338, but 176 were companies. Earlier this week at a conference hosted by the Alberta Securities Commission, McKenzie said he’d like to see reduced regulatory barriers and cost relief for companies looking to go public on the TSX. The exchange has increasingly become home to “fewer, bigger companies, which in some ways is great,” he said, noting that larger firms are better able to compete globally. “But at the same time, if we hollow out that middle of the market, it makes it more difficult for small, big-cap companies to find the capital they need to scale up to become the next Enbridge or Shopify or RBC,” McKenzie told the conference. “We want to make sure that the ecosystem still exists.” With files from The Canadian Press

items.title: ¿Hackeo a Binance afectó operaciones y cuentas en Venezuela?
items.author: Fátima Romero
items.summary: El hackeo a Binance puso en pausa los retiros de una plataforma utilizada por venezolanos para operar con USDT.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — Binance, el exchange de criptomonedas más grande del mundo, sufrió el mayor robo registrado en el sector: unos US$6.300 millones salieron de sus billeteras calientes el jueves 29 de octubre, según la propia empresa. Ver más: Hackeo a Binance 2026: qué es el fondo SAFU y cómo cubrirá las pérdidas de los usuarios a nivel global En Venezuela, los anuncios de compraventa de Binance P2P continuaron activos durante el incidente y después, mientras el precio del USDT registró variaciones moderadas. Lo que sí cambió fue el acceso a los fondos: los retiros están pausados desde el jueves y Binance dijo este viernes que espera reactivarlos en unas 48 horas. El país es un mercado central para el dólar digital. “En Venezuela, millones de personas usan USDT para cobrar, ahorrar y pagar. Muchos lo guardan en un exchange porque es lo más práctico”, dijo Rafael Núñez , CEO de MásQueSeguridad, en LinkedIn. Los registros de Binance P2P muestran que la actividad de compraventa continuó durante el incidente. El sistema de monitoreo del sitio informativo independiente El Cambio VE , que rastrea los anuncios de esta plataforma cada minuto, siguió detectándolos tanto durante el ataque como después. El promedio del USDT pasó de 1.011,59 bolívares el miércoles 28 a 1.010,75 el jueves, y este viernes a las 6:33 cotizaba en 1.006,00: una variación de menos de 0,5%. Según la investigación inicial de Binance, el punto de entrada fue la laptop comprometida de un ingeniero DevOps. Desde ese equipo, el atacante accedió a un contenedor de servicio interno que participa en el proceso de retiros y envió transacciones no autorizadas. Los fondos salieron en diez blockchains, entre ellas Bitcoin y Ethereum, a partir de las 16:05 (hora de Venezuela), según TRM Labs. Ver más: Binance en Venezuela: ¿cuáles son las implicaciones contables y fiscales de operar con bolívares? El drenaje duró unos 20 minutos, según el recuento de Núñez. Binance dijo que no halló evidencia de filtración de claves privadas. “Las claves quedaron intactas. El atacante tomó el sistema que les dice qué firmar”, explicó Núñez. Este viernes, Binance calificó el ataque de “complejo” y dijo que está “haciendo todo lo posible en coordinación con las fuerzas del orden para resolverlo”. Tres firmas de inteligencia de blockchain —TRM Labs, Chainalysis y Elliptic— atribuyen el ataque con alta confianza a TraderTraitor, la unidad de hackers de Corea del Norte vinculada al grupo Lazarus. Binance no ha confirmado la atribución. El FBI y el Servicio Secreto de Estados Unidos dijeron que investigan el caso, y las autoridades estadounidenses han documentado que ese grupo suele atacar a ingenieros con ofertas de empleo falsas y aplicaciones troyanizadas. Del monto total robado, unos US$3.000 millones ya están congelados en la blockchain con ayuda de socios de la industria. Tether bloqueó más de US$1.500 millones en USDT y Circle, US$800 millones en USDC. Arkham Intelligence, que rastreó 55 billeteras vinculadas al robo, calcula que unos US$5.700 millones salieron de las billeteras calientes. “Esa parte del botín se frenó porque alguien tenía autoridad, herramientas y la decisión tomada antes de que hiciera falta”, dijo Núñez. El monto es más de cuatro veces el récord anterior: el ataque al exchange Bybit en febrero de 2025, de casi US$1.500 millones. La escala del robo cobra peso en un exchange que custodia unos US$135.200 millones en activos, casi cinco veces los del segundo más grande, OKX, según datos de DefiLlama. La empresa asegura que los fondos de los usuarios están a salvo y que cubrirá todas las pérdidas con el fondo SAFU —una reserva creada en 2018 para emergencias, que se mantiene en torno a los 1.000 millones de dólares— y con recursos propios. Mientras la investigación continúa, Binance prometió que publicará un informe técnico completo y que los retiros podrían reactivarse el domingo. El robo se suma a una racha de incidentes que incluye drenajes en Bitget, vulneraciones en dispositivos Ledger y, el mismo día del ataque, una intrusión en Polymarket que dejó US$2,7 millones sustraídos a unos 700 usuarios, según la plataforma Bubblemaps. En tanto, el bitcoin ( XBTUSD ) cayó por debajo de los US$77.000 tras la noticia. Para Núñez, el caso muestra el riesgo que corren las empresas que mueven dinero: el ingeniero DevOps construye y mantiene el software interno y, para hacerlo, necesita acceso a casi todo —servidores, nubes, bases de datos y herramientas de automatización—. Es, en sus palabras, como el empleado con la llave maestra del edificio, incluida la bóveda. Y esa llave vive en una laptop que también sirve para el correo y la navegación cotidiana. Ver más: Binance estima en US$6.300 millones el mayor hackeo de la historia de las criptomonedas “Eso es lo que llevo años llamando el trusted insider : la persona de confianza con acceso privilegiado a quien el atacante convierte en su puerta, casi siempre sin que actúe de mala fe”, dijo. En investigaciones forenses que ha hecho en Venezuela, asegura haber visto el patrón repetirse: contraseñas compartidas, accesos de administrador desde equipos personales y permisos de urgencias pasadas que nunca se retiran. El peligro más cercano para los usuarios no está en la blockchain sino en los mensajes que llegan tras el ataque. “Después de cada hackeo grande llegan los falsos ‘reembolsos’, los formularios de verificación y los soportes técnicos por WhatsApp”, advirtió Núñez. Y para el dinero que no se necesite operar esta semana, la recomendación del experto es moverlo a una wallet propia. Binance, por su lado, pidió confiar únicamente en sus canales oficiales y recordó que nadie legítimo pedirá el código de doble factor ni la frase semilla de la billetera.

MANCHESTER, England, Oct 30 : Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca brushed aside questions about the number of red cards players received during his spell at Chelsea after a tense exchange with a reporter on Friday, saying he did not view the issue as a concern.
Asked about Chelsea's disciplinary problems at the press conference ahead of Premier League leaders City's clash at home to third-placed Brighton & Hove Albion on Saturday, the Italian questioned whether that was before or after his departure.
"When I was there or when I left?" asked Maresca, who departed from Chelsea on New Year's Day this year.
After the reporter clarified the question related to his tenure, Maresca replied: "You lack information. When I was there... when I left."

Asked if it was an issue, he said: "I don't think so."
Six Chelsea players received red cards in just over two months from September to November before Maresca left the club.
Chelsea finished on 118 cards in the Premier League last season, six clear of nearest rivals Tottenham Hotspur, and racked up 11 reds in all competitions. 
Turning to team news, Maresca said the only City player unavailable to face Brighton was forward Antoine Semenyo.
The Italian also expressed satisfaction with progress made during his opening months in charge at City, having rejoined the club at the end of June, saying they were moving in the right direction despite significant changes on and off the pitch.
City are top with 21 points from eight matches, above Arsenal on goal difference and five points clear of Brighton.
"We're going in the right direction," Maresca said. "I think, in this moment, we are competing, and we changed many players, changed manager. But the good thing about the club is that, in this moment, I think we are competing in all competitions and we know that it takes time."
Maresca's first months at the helm have coincided with the club being found guilty of 114 breaches of Premier League financial rules. City have denied any wrongdoing and appealed.

Oct 30 : OpenAI said on Friday it is tightening limits on the weapons-related information ChatGPT provides to teens, even when a question appears harmless, as part of new safeguards aimed at preventing real-world violence.
The move comes as AI companies face growing scrutiny over the risks chatbots pose to young users and the companies' role in detecting threats of harm.
Here are more details:
• OpenAI will restrict practical information on weapons and security systems that could be misused, with the limits applying to teens even when there is no sign of violent intent

• For all users, ChatGPT will be able to automatically end chats where someone appears to be fixating on violence, and OpenAI may temporarily pause accounts after multiple such chats
• The company also said it strengthened its age prediction system to move users it estimates are under 18 into the teen experience, and it plans to notify parents if their teen's account is paused for repeatedly discussing violence
• For all users, OpenAI is limiting detail on past mass attacks, including the weapons used and how they were obtained
• The company said the new safeguards will begin rolling out in the next few weeks, and it will continue to refine them
• OpenAI said earlier this month that teens spend under 15 minutes a day on average on ChatGPT, in its first report on teen use
• A report by non-profit Common Sense Media earlier this month found that ChatGPT's teen version often alerted parents late or not at all when teen accounts held conversations about suicide, self-harm or eating disorders

Drone strikes on Ethiopia displacement camp kill at least 15, sources say

Reuters

NAIROBI, Oct 30 (Reuters) – At least 15 people, several of them children, died in a series of drone strikes that hit a camp for displaced civilians in Ethiopia’s Amhara region, two sources involved in a rescue operation said on Friday.

It was not clear why the camp was targeted or who was behind the attack, but the strikes highlight continuing clashes in the area despite a lull in the heavy fighting that erupted last month between an alliance of rebels from northern Tigray region and the government in Addis Ababa.

“There were around five explosions. Then … we started collecting bodies,” a community representative involved in the burials told Reuters, asking not to be named due to the sensitivity of the issue.

Show Full Article

The representative said they helped bury 13 people at the camp, which is known as Jari 2 and is home to more than 1,700 people who fled previous violence.

Two of the injured later died at a hospital in Hayk, a town 17 km (10 miles) away. 

A spokesperson for Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed did not immediately respond to requests for comment. A local official said they were aware of the incident and were helping get medical treatment to 36 people who had been injured. 

A man who lost a family member described seeing a drone circling overhead on Wednesday and then returning on Thursday.

“Then finally it hit the camp … three times,” the relative told Reuters. “Their body parts were scattered everywhere. We collected and buried pieces of their body parts.”

NO FIGHTING IN THE AREA WHEN CAMP HIT

A resident of Hayk who was helping provide shelter to survivors also said 15 people had been killed. “Those from the camp are now sheltering in a school,” the resident said.

The dead included five children, according to the two sources involved in the rescue. 

The relative of one of the victims said they had seen at least 10 injured children under the aged of five receiving treatment.

All three sources said there had been no fighting in the area when the strike took place, but members of the Amhara Fano National Movement, which is part of the rebel alliance spearheaded by fighters from Tigray, had been nearby. 

Government troops have driven back the rebel alliance since their offensive was launched on September 23.

They retook the capital of Tigray region earlier this month and advanced towards the border with Eritrea, which Ethiopia accuses of supporting the rebellion by sending troops over the border. 

Eritrea denies the accusation and says Addis Ababa’s allegations of an invasion by Eritrean forces amounted to a “declaration of war”. 

Given the web of interconnected conflicts in the Horn of Africa, with neighbouring countries and powers further afield backing their respective proxies, experts have warned that war in Ethiopia could trigger a broader conflict in the region.

(Reporting by Nairobi Newsroom; Writing by David Lewis; Editing by David Holmes and Ros Russell)

[ロンドン ３０日 ロイター] - 英石油大手のＢＰが３０日に発表した２０２６年７─９月期（２６年第３・四半期）決算は、純利益に相当する実質再調達原価利益が８４億６０００万ドルと、現指標の採用を始めて以降の四半期ベースで過去最高となった。前年同期の２２億ドル、アナリスト予想の７３億３０００万ドルをいずれも上回った。中東情勢に伴うエネルギー価格高騰や精製マージンの拡大が寄与した。

２９日に四半期決算を発表した英シェルと仏トタルエナジーズも利益が市場予想を上回り、自社株買い計画の拡大を決定した。

ＢＰは、余剰キャッシュの一部について、１０年に起きたメキシコ湾沖の石油掘削施設「ディープウォーター・ホライズン」の原油流出事故に伴う残存債務に充てる方針を示した。

メグ・オニール最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、自社株買い再開や配当増の可能性に関して、現配当を維持するために債務削減に注力すると説明した。オニール氏は声明で、石油・ガスの生産量は日量約２２０万バレルを維持しているとし、「上流部門のプラントの信頼性と精製設備の稼働率は、前四半期に比べていずれも改善し、トレーディング部門の業績も向上した」と言及した。

営業キャッシュフローは１４８億ドル。一方、純負債は１３９億ドルに減少し、目標を１年前倒しで達成した。指標精製マージンは１バレル＝４６．７ドルと、４─６月期の２９．６ドル、前年同期の１５．８ドルから上昇。主に太陽光発電事業や洋上風力発電の関連で４０億ドルの減損を計上した。

ＢＰは、１２月１５日に長期計画に関する最新情報を発表する予定だ。

items.title: The sell-off for tech stocks deepens and drags Wall Street toward its worst day since June
items.author: The Associated Press
items.summary: A sell-off for tech stocks is getting worse Friday on worries that Wall Street’s frenzy around AI sent prices too high.
items.body: NEW YORK — A sell-off for tech stocks is getting worse Friday on worries that Wall Street’s frenzy around AI sent prices too high. The S&P 500 dropped 1.8 per cent and was on track to erase its gain for October, even though it set its all-time high during the month. The Nasdaq composite was likewise heading toward its worst day since June, as the weakness for technology stocks dragged it down three per cent, as of 12:55 p.m. Eastern time. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 496 points, or 0.9 per cent. Intel’s stock led the way downward and is flirting with its worst day since 1974 after tumbling 30.1 per cent. The chipmaker gave a forecast for profit in the final three months of this year that fell short of analysts’ expectations, as CEO Lip-Bu Tan said the personal-computer industry continues to feel pressure. The drop came even though Intel reported a stronger profit for the latest quarter than analysts expected. Amazon sank 2.3 per cent after reporting a weaker profit for the summer than analysts expected. Potentially more concerning for investors was Amazon’s reporting that it burned through US$42.4 billion of cash over the prior 12 months, according to a measure called free cash flow. It spent $94.8 billion on property and equipment, primarily through investments in artificial-intelligence technology. A day earlier, Alphabet’s stock dropped more than 12 per cent to its worst day on record and almost single-handedly dragged the S&P 500 lower after telling investors it burned through more cash during the summer than the spring. The company behind Google and YouTube cited similar, mammoth investments in AI. Worries are rising about whether all those hundreds of billions of dollars will produce enough profit and productivity to make the investment worth it. At the same time, stocks of computer chip companies and other winners from the frenzy to build AI data centers have come under pressure on concerns that high interest rates may slow the further build out of data centers. “We’re moving out of the hopes and dreams phase of the AI trade and into the ‘show me’ phase,” said Joe Tigay, portfolio manager at Equity Armor Investments, in a note to investors. A drop of 4.7 per cent for the stock price of Nvidia, whose chips have made it the poster child of the AI frenzy, was the heaviest force pulling the S&P 500 downward, even more than Intel. In the cryptocurrency industry, meanwhile, stocks tumbled following a hack on the world’s biggest crypto exchange. The price of bitcoin fell toward $77,000 from more than $86,000 earlier this month, and a U.S.-based blockchain intelligence firm said a North Korean unit was likely behind the attack that impacted more than $6 billion worth of crypto at Binance. Coinbase Global fell 12.9 per cent even though it reported stronger results for the latest quarter than analysts expected. Strategy, which says it owns about four per cent of the total supply of bitcoin, fell six per cent. It also reported a stronger profit for the latest quarter than analysts expected, while saying its chief financial officer will resign next week for personal reasons. Outside of tech, stocks were more resilient as many rallied after reporting stronger profits for the summer than analysts expected. Nearly as many stocks rose in the S&P 500 index as fell. ExxonMobil climbed 1.8 per cent, and Chevron added 1.6 per cent after the oil giants both reported stronger profit for the summer than analysts expected. Mondelez International rose 3.7 per cent after the company behind Oreo cookies and Ritz crackers reported stronger-than-expected growth. Colgate-Palmolive climbed 3.5 per cent after higher prices for its products around much of the world helped it deliver better revenue and profit than analysts expected. Expectations are high for U.S. companies’ ability to make bigger profits, even though people around the world are feeling discouraged about high inflation and high fuel prices. Such expectations are what drove the S&P 500 to its record earlier this month. In the bond market, Treasury yields eased in a signal that investors were buying U.S. government bonds in search of something safer to own. The yield on the 10-year Treasury fell to 4.94 per cent from 4.98 per cent late Thursday and from more than 5.30 per cent earlier this month. Treasury yields fell even though oil prices bounced higher, something that usually drives yields higher because it worsens inflation. The price for a barrel of Brent crude oil rose 2.4 per cent to $113.50. It’s near the high end of its range since the war with Iran sent oil prices and inflation higher. In stock markets abroad, indexes were mostly lower in Europe following sharper swings in Asia. South Korea’s Kospi dropped 3.5 per cent as worries about AI hit its tech-heavy market, while the Hang Seng in Hong Kong climbed 1.5 per cent. Japan’s Nikkei 225 fell 2.1 per cent after the Bank of Japan decided to keep interest rates steady, echoing moves made earlier in the week by the U.S. Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank. ___ AP Business Writers Yuri Kageyama and Michelle Chapman contributed to this report. By Stan Choe

items.title: Intel stock plunges 30% as weak PC demand and AI costs trigger global chip selloff
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: Intel shares plunged 30% after the chipmaker issued a weak fourth-quarter revenue forecast and warned of negative cash flow for the year. The warning triggered a global semiconductor selloff, with Nvidia, AMD and other chip stocks declining as weak PC demand and rising AI infrastructure costs weighed on sentiment.
items.body: Intel shares tumbled 30% on Friday after the chipmaker issued a weaker than expected revenue outlook and warned that it would not generate positive cash flow this year. The warning added to concerns over slowing PC demand and the mounting costs of expanding artificial intelligence infrastructure, triggering a broader selloff across semiconductor stocks, Reuters reported.Intel stock was trading at $64.54, down 29.9%, after having fallen to a low of $64.11 earlier in the day.The weakness extended beyond Intel, with shares of Advanced Micro Devices, Arm Holdings, Qualcomm, Nvidia, Broadcom and Micron falling between 2% and 9% in premarket trading. The selloff also hit companies supplying equipment and infrastructure to the semiconductor industry, reflecting growing investor caution over the AI investment cycle.For live updates on US Markets, click here The market is in a sell first, ask questions later mood right now, and Intel's warning has given investors an easy excuse to take some money off the table across chip stocks, said Matt Britzman, senior equity analyst at Hargreaves Lansdown, according to Reuters.Intel turnaround faces fresh hurdlesIntel's outlook has raised fresh questions about CEO Lip Bu Tan's efforts to revive the chipmaker, which continues to struggle with a prolonged downturn in the personal computer market while spending heavily on manufacturing expansion and AI related opportunities.The company forecast fourth quarter revenue of $15 billion to $16 billion, below analysts' average estimate of $17.07 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Finance chief David Zinsner also said Intel does not expect to generate positive cash flow this year, Reuters reported.Read more: Nasdaq sinks 2.2% as Amazon, Intel fuel fresh fears over AI spendingIntel was on track to lose more than $123 billion in market value.Memory costs add to PC market pressureRising memory prices are creating another challenge for the chipmaker. Suppliers are shifting production capacity towards high bandwidth memory chips used in AI systems, pushing up PC costs and putting further pressure on consumer demand.PC chips contributed roughly half of Intel's third quarter revenue. The company expects sales from the segment to decline more than 20% sequentially in the current quarter, following a 5% drop in the September quarter, Reuters reported. It will be important to see if Intel can expand the highly profitable Xeon product supply to help offset this developing weakness in PC, said Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management.He added, Bottom line, weaker sales volumes, higher manufacturing costs, and an out of cycle product mix is a recipe for the stock to decline over the near term as future earnings are under a lot of pressure. (Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

items.title: Economic growth stalled again in August, StatCan says
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Statistics Canada says the economy stalled for a second month in a row in August, and early estimates suggest growth declined in September.
items.body: Signs that economic growth stalled over the summer have some economists debating the timing of the Bank of Canada’s next interest rate hike. Statistics Canada said Friday that real gross domestic product was essentially unchanged for a second straight month in August. That fell short of economists’ calls and the agency’s own early expectations for a gain of 0.2 per cent in the month. Wholesale trade fell 1.4 per cent in August as most subsectors contracted. StatCan said motor vehicle and vehicle parts wholesalers faced their first decline in seven months amid lower vehicle imports and weaker manufacturing activity in the subsector. StatCan cited a “prolonged summer shutdown at a major auto assembly plant” to explain a 5.8 per cent decline in motor vehicles and parts manufacturing in August. Tu Nguyen, chief economist at RSM Canada, said what’s notable about the August declines in these sectors is they would only partially capture the impacts of a breakdown in trade talks between Canada and the United States that month. Both sides have since levied new waves of tariffs and trade restrictions against one another. Manufacturing and wholesale trade — sectors that are particularly vulnerable to tariff disruptions — will continue to see regular contractions under the re-escalated trade dispute, Nguyen said. Elsewhere, StatCan said work to prepare the 2026 census was still winding down in August, driving widespread contractions in public administration. Maintenance work at some nuclear power plants and mining facilities in northern Alberta also dragged on growth that month, StatCan said. Retail trade, manufacturing as a whole and the transportation and warehousing industries were among those posting gains to offset the declines in August. StatCan’s early estimates for September suggest real GDP declined 0.1 per cent, driven by losses in manufacturing and mining, quarrying and oil and gas extraction. The agency’s flash estimates still see real GDP expanding 1.3 per cent on an annualized basis in the third quarter, a slowdown from 3.3 per cent growth in the second quarter. StatCan will provide its official quarterly estimates for the third quarter next month when it reports the September GDP figures. BMO chief economist Doug Porter said in a note to clients Friday that some of the weakness last quarter might be overstated, particularly as it relates to census-related slowdowns. “Still, with the trade tiff still flaring, housing struggling, and recent employment figures concerning, it certainly appears that growth has run into some pretty serious headwinds of late,” he said. The latest economic data comes two days after the Bank of Canada raised its benchmark interest rate by a quarter point to 2.5 per cent, the first hike in more than three years. An increase to the central bank’s key rate will typically take some steam out of the economy, though most analysts still see current monetary policy levels as somewhat stimulative. Officials at the central bank argued this week that a rate hike was warranted to get ahead of looming inflation risks. Governor Tiff Macklem pointed to signs of resilience in the Canadian economy over the spring in justifying the decision. The central bank also revised up its expectations for growth on Wednesday. Monetary policymakers are expecting growth in the third quarter ended up at two per cent on an annualized basis, up from 1.5 per cent in its July forecasts. Many economists weighing in Friday argued the Bank of Canada’s somewhat rosier projections are at risk after StatCan data suggested middling growth in the third quarter. BMO, which had been in line with the central bank’s call for two per cent growth, trimmed its outlook to 1.5 per cent after Friday’s surprise. The Bank of Canada is expecting a further slowdown in the fourth quarter will give way to real GDP growth of two per cent in 2027 and 2028. Nguyen said despite the recent stumbles, there are reasons for optimism in the year ahead. Government spending priorities for a build out of major projects and tax incentives for business investment should give the economy a lift in 2027, she argued. Andrew Grantham, senior economist at CIBC, said in a note that the August data suggested the economy “was already struggling for momentum even before this week’s interest rate hike.” A slower-than-expected economy could help relieve inflationary pressures and reduce the need for additional rate hikes, he added. The weak GDP results support a pause from the Bank of Canada at its final rate decision of the year in December, Grantham said, though he noted there’s plenty of additional economic data to come before that meeting. Financial market odds of an interest rate hike on Dec. 9 stood at 57 per cent as of Friday morning, according to LSEG Data & Analytics. Nguyen said it’s a “coin flip” whether the Bank of Canada hikes in December or its next meeting in January. But given Macklem’s comments this week focused on economic resilience and inflationary fears, she said she leans toward a second quarter-point hike sooner than later. “A 25-basis-point hike, one month apart, whether in December or in January, I don’t think would change too much in terms of growth trajectory,” she said. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 30, 2026. By Craig Lord

items.title: Ｇ２０外相、米国務長官が協調促す　ロシア参加で溝深まる
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Andrea Shalal

[アトランタ ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Andrea Shalal

[アトランタ ３０日 ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は３０日、アトランタで開かれた２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）外相会合の冒頭で、一連の危機が世界の経済秩序に深刻な脅威をもたらしていると警告し、地政学的な安定と経済的な繁栄の拡大に向けて協力するよう呼びかけた。世界はエネルギー・食料供給や貿易、航行の自由を脅かすさまざまな危機に直面していると指摘した上で、「われわれには、それぞれの国を代表し、互いに協力して新たな危機への対応を調整し、共通の利益を守る責務がある。地政学的な安定の拡大と、首脳らが取り組む幅広い経済的繁栄の課題に向けた環境を整えることができる」と語った。

今回の会合は２日間の日程で開かれる。

しかし、会合にロシアのラブロフ外相が参加したことに、多くのＧ２０外相が反発。ウクライナと中東の戦争を巡る深い溝が一段と広がっており、専門家や外交官は会合で実質的な進展が妨げられる可能性があると指摘する。

ラブロフ氏の参加を批判してきたカナダのアナンド外相は、冒頭の全体会合を欠席した。同氏の報道官によると、モントリオールでのカナダ・欧州連合（ＥＵ）首脳会議に出席していたため、到着が遅れているという。

南アフリカの外相も欠席した。２０２６年の議長国である米国が招待しなかった。

欧州の一部当局者がラブロフ氏との写真撮影に応じないと表明したことを受け、恒例のＧ２０集合写真の撮影はルビオ氏の公式日程から外された。西側の外交官によると、オーストラリアとカナダを含む参加者の３分の１が反対した。

ドイツのワーデフール外相は記者団に対し、集合写真の撮影自体が取りやめになるとの見通しを示した。「欧州のパートナーとラブロフ氏が一緒に集合写真に収まることは決してない。２９日に述べたように、ロシアと通常通りに付き合うことはできない」と語った。

米国は、重要鉱物に対する中国の支配に対抗する連携を構築する一方、同盟国の関心を貿易不均衡に向けようとしてきた。しかし、多くのＧ２０加盟国にとって最大の懸念は依然として戦争とその経済的な影響だ。

オバマ政権時代に米国務省のチーフエコノミストを務めたハイジ・クレボレディカー氏は、Ｇ２０加盟国のロシア、中国や、ブラジルやインドなどの中堅国が米中の戦略的競争への対応を模索する中、「これまでにないほど分裂が深まっている」と指摘した。過去１０年余り、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）は少なくとも「Ｇ２０に臨む前に共通の方針で合意していたが、今はそれすらできていない」と述べた。

items.author: CNA
items.summary: The crash, which killed at least 69 people, marks the second deadly rail accident this year involving the same railway companies.
items.body:
