Spanish minister refuses to resign over second major train crash on his watch

The crash, which killed at least 69 people, marks the second deadly rail accident this year involving the same railway companies.

Spanish Transport Minister Oscar Puente speaks during a press conference to provide details on the deadly train crash near Toledo, in Madrid, Spain, Oct 30, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Juan Barbosa)

31 Oct 2026 01:00AM

MADRID: Spain's transport minister on Friday (Oct 30) rejected calls for his resignation over the second train accident on his watch to cause mass casualties this year, as authorities worked to identify the victims from a crash that killed at least 69 people.
Lawmakers from across the political spectrum this week condemned Transport Minister Oscar Puente for attributing Wednesday's crash to a break in protocol by control centre operators rather than accepting responsibility, with rail workers' unions calling for his immediate dismissal.
The crash, which happened near the town of Urda in central Spain, followed another accident involving the same rail companies on the same line that killed 46 people in January.
It has reopened a debate about safety and maintenance on Spain's high-speed rail network, the most extensive in Europe, as the country prepares for an election that left-leaning Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez has called for Nov 29.

"My duty now is not to focus on discussing whether I will remain in office, but on solving the problem, determining exactly what happened and providing clear explanations," Puente said at a press conference on Friday.
At the scene of the crash, large cranes were lifting the mangled wreckage as the Civil Guard listed 64 people as missing in what is already Spain's deadliest train accident since 2013. It was unclear if all those missing were accounted for in the death toll.
Authorities have carried out 49 autopsies so far and formally identified five people, three women and two men, Esther Padilla, spokesperson for the Castilla-La Mancha regional government, said on state television network TVE.

Cranes lift wrecked train carriages as rescuers search for victims following a collision between two trains in Urda, Spain, Thursday, Oct 29, 2026. (Photo: AP/Manu Fernandez)

AUTHORITIES CAN'T RULE OUT MORE FATALITIES No additional bodies were found when rescue teams overturned a train carriage on Thursday, Castilla-La Mancha regional leader Emiliano Garcia-Page said on TVE.
Identifying the bodies was proving difficult because many were in pieces, he said. On Thursday, rescue teams had placed partial remains in 31 bags.
"We cannot rule out the possibility of more fatalities," Garcia-Page said.
The collision occurred after several trains were automatically stopped due to the failure of a signalling system, after which the central control centre in Madrid took over. A train operated by state-owned Renfe was authorised to proceed, even though there was a stationary Iryo-operated train ahead, according to Puente.
Audio of communications between the control centre and the train drivers obtained by El Pais showed how a controller authorised the Renfe train to continue on its journey at a normal speed, which Puente said disregarded a protocol to travel at no more than 40 kph in such circumstances.

CONTROLLERS SAY FOCUS SHOULD BE ON FAILED SIGNAL SYSTEM The debate about who was at fault intensified, with unions saying it was unfair to lay the blame on human error.
Raquel Ayllon, a union leader at state-owned infrastructure operator Adif, said controllers were having to operate under difficult working conditions.
"Human error is being criticised and questioned very quickly, while people are not really focusing on the central issue: the failure of the safety system," Ayllon said on TVE.
Puente said the number of staff working at the control centre in Madrid had almost doubled since 2012 and that the controller who made the call had been working for two hours when the crash occurred.
"I have never used the term 'human error', although that is not to say that there was no human error," he said.
He said the LZB train control system that failed on Wednesday had an average of 170 failures per year, which was about the same as the rest of Europe.
The system was behind schedule for an upgrade, public documents show.

Related:

Spain working 'tirelessly' to identify train crash dead: PM

Grieving Spain demands answers for latest rail disaster that killed 69 people

The European Rail Traffic Management System (ERTMS) has been installed across most of Spanish high-speed rail, according to a factsheet by European rail association UNIFE, which developed the new standard.
Thales España, the Spanish arm of the French equipment maker, won a 2021 contract to install the ERTMS on the Madrid-Seville line, site of the two fatal crashes, by early 2026, but the work fell behind and passed to Hitachi Rail in 2024, according to Thales.
Thales declined to comment on the delay of the rollout.
Puente said the ERTMS system on the Madrid-Seville line was expected to begin working in early 2027, adding that the delay was due to the complexity of installing the system while keeping the line in operation.

Source: Reuters/fs

items.title: Nvidia in talks to give credit support for Nscale's deal with Anthropic
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: Nvidia is reportedly considering billions of dollars in credit guarantees to help Nscale finance a West Virginia AI data centre for Anthropic, though the deal has not been finalised.
items.body: Nvidia is in talks to offer AI cloud provider Nscale billions of dollars in credit guarantees to support debt funding for a data center earmarked for Anthropic, The Information reported on Thursday, citing people with knowledge of the talks. The credit support would help fund power infrastructure and construction of Nscale's AI data centre in West Virginia, which Anthropic plans to use, according to the report. Nvidia is an investor in the UK-based cloud provider. The deal has not been signed and terms could still change, the report said. Nvidia, Nscale and Anthropic did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment. Claude maker Anthropic struck a deal in August to spend $45 billion to rent computing power from Nscale's West Virginia data center campus. Nscale is also in talks to sell about 460 megawatts of AI computing power to Anthropic in another deal that could also be worth about $45 billion. The report comes as companies such as CoreWeave and Firmus, which are both backed by Nvidia, have been hit by concerns about debt financing behind the AI build-out.

FAST

NEW YORK/LONDON, Oct 30 : A sharp selloff in Wall Street's tech shares pushed MSCI's global index down more than 1 per cent on Friday, sending investors to the safety of US bonds on fears that hefty cash-burning AI investments may not deliver sufficient returns. 
Shares in chipmaker Intel plunged 28 per cent and Amazon shares were off 1.9 per cent after their results each showed they burned through cash while investing heavily in AI-related development. Intel also said PC demand had slowed, and that it could persist through next year.
Shares in Google parent Alphabet, after falling 12.6 per cent on Thursday, extended losses on Friday. Its massive AI spending turned the company cash flow negative while its search business faced stiff competition.
"It's really been a horror show this morning and the real villain is AI spending," said Gene Goldman, chief investment officer at Cetera, saying the heavy cash burn and elevated capex are prompting questions about whether the AI returns will "justify the outlays."

Goldman also said pressure from rising oil prices due to more attacks in the Middle East and concerns about a hack at Binance, the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange, added to the gloom. Bitcoin and other cryptocurrency prices fell.
Outside tech, other sectors were holding up, particularly energy, which rose following results from Exxon Mobil and Chevron. The oil majors posted strong profits due to big refining margins driven by supply disruptions from Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries and the US-Israel war on Iran. Shares rose 1.3 per cent and 3 per cent, respectively.
On Wall Street at 12:09 p.m. ET (1609 GMT), the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 384.61 points, or 0.73 per cent, to 51,957.95, the S&P 500 fell 124.20 points, or 1.61 per cent, to 7,595.93 and the Nasdaq Composite fell 684.06 points, or 2.61 per cent, to 25,500.67. 
MSCI's gauge of stocks across the globe fell 15.62 points, or 1.4 per cent, to 1,117.00.
The pan-European STOXX 600 index fell 0.46 per cent.
In currencies, the yen headed for a third daily gain on Friday after the Bank of Japan held rates steady but revised up its inflation forecast, while a fresh wave of selling in AI shares triggered demand for non-dollar safe havens.  
The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies including the yen and the euro, fell 0.03 per cent to 101.85, with the euro down 0.07 per cent at $1.117.
Against the Japanese yen, the dollar weakened 0.2 per cent to 157.37.
Bitcoin fell 1.80 per cent to $77,424.37. 
US Treasuries rose, putting benchmark 10-year yields on track for their biggest monthly decline since late 2023, as the tech-stock selloff pushed investors into safe havens. 
The yield on benchmark US 10-year notes fell 4.36 basis points to 4.945 per cent while the 30-year bond yield  fell 0.69 basis points to 5.3221 per cent.
The 2-year note yield, which typically moves in step with interest rate expectations for the Federal Reserve, fell 5.4 basis points to 4.602 per cent.
Oil prices were on track for a fourth straight monthly gain. Traders are bracing for a potential escalation in the US-Iran conflict after the US midterm elections. The war has lingered for eight months without a resolution, and on Friday, a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz was attacked, highlighting the ongoing supply risks. 
US crude rose 2 per cent to $104.09 a barrel and Brent rose to $117.58 per barrel, up 2.4 per cent on the day.
Precious metals fell. Gold dropped to a one-year low on Friday and silver slid below $50 an ounce for the first time since November 2025 as higher energy prices and persistent inflation concerns strengthened expectations that US interest rates will stay high.
Spot gold fell 3 per cent to $3,901.83 an ounce. Spot silver fell 5.9 per cent to $49.27 an ounce.

Source: Reuters

Oct 30 : Tottenham Hotspur midfielder James Maddison is available to face Crystal Palace in the Premier League on Saturday despite an injury scare, boss Roberto De Zerbi said on Friday.
• The England international was substituted early in the second half of Spurs' 2-0 win at Chelsea, raising concerns over his fitness after a series of injury setbacks
• Maddison missed most of last season with an ACL injury and also spent time out in this campaign with a shoulder injury suffered in his side's opening-weekend defeat at Brentford.
• He marked his return to the starting lineup by opening the scoring against Coventry City earlier this month

items.title: Gold price slumps to one-year low, silver price breaks $50 as mining stocks tank
items.author: Frik Els
items.creator: Frik Els
items.summary: Bullion is headed for its worst October since 2008, dragging down gold and silver producers as much as 8% on Friday.
items.body:
Gold price slumps to one-year low, silver price breaks $50 as mining stocks tank

Staff Writer | October 30, 2026 | 9:31 am
Iran War   Markets   Canada   Middle East   USA   Gold   Silver  

Edited stock image.

Gold fell to its lowest in a year on Friday and silver dropped below $50 an ounce as rising oil prices hardened bets on another Federal Reserve rate hike and a deepening rout in technology stocks forced investors to sell the metals to cover losses elsewhere, dragging gold and silver producers down as much as 8%.

Spot gold fell as much as 3.2% to $3,891.67 an ounce, its weakest since Oct. 28 last year, and was trading down 2.7% at $3,910.53 by late morning in New York. Comex gold for December delivery dropped 3.1% to $3,907.90 an ounce after touching $3,900.90, a week after sliding below $4,000 for the first time since July .

Click on chart for live prices.

Silver fared worse, sliding 5.8% to $49.34 an ounce, its first time under $50 since November 2025, and is down roughly 18% for the month. The metal has now given back everything it gained since early December, when it began the two-month run that carried it above $120. Comex silver for December delivery fell as much as 6.3% to $49.08 an ounce and was last down 5.9% at $49.31.

Click on chart for live prices.

Volumes were heavy for this point in the session, with futures covering a nominal 18 million ounces of gold and 236 million ounces of silver changing hands on the Comex by midday in New York.

Gold is on track for a drop of about 6% in October, its worst showing for the month since 2008, when the global financial crisis was upending markets, and a second straight monthly decline. Bullion now trades about 28% below the record close of $5,419.83 it set on January 28.

The selling came from two directions. The prospect of renewed US military action against Iran, including an attack on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, pushed Brent crude to its highest since April and oil toward a fourth straight monthly gain, reinforcing the inflation worries that prompted the Fed in September to raise rates for the first time since July 2023. The Fed and the European Central Bank both held this week but pointed to inflation risks from surging energy costs, and data on Thursday showed US inflation accelerated in September; traders now price a more than 70% chance of a Fed hike in December.

“The indication was that the higher-for-longer theme prevails,” Peter Grant, senior metals strategist at Zaner Metals, told Reuters, adding that inflation worries have multiple central banks continuing to tilt hawkish.

At the same time, technology shares led global stocks lower for a second day as another round of disappointing earnings accelerated a rotation out of the artificial intelligence trade and into Treasuries, with the Nasdaq set for steep losses on worries about AI spending.

“Gold is getting caught up in the momentum,” said Bart Melek, global head of commodity strategy at TD Securities, who told Bloomberg that higher oil is triggering a risk-off bid for Treasuries that drains liquidity from equities and bullion alike. Trend followers are now testing long-term support in both metals, he added.

Analysts at Commerzbank said the fall in tech stocks may have prompted margin calls and forced selling, but called the decline in precious metals exaggerated and still expect a recovery.

Physical buyers are not stepping in yet. Demand in India remained subdued this week as buyers held off in anticipation of lower prices, Reuters reported, and demand in top consumer China stayed muted, even as Asian investors have been picking up gold-backed funds that North American investors are dumping.

Silver’s slide has pushed the gold-silver ratio to its highest since December. Ole Hansen, head of commodity strategy at Saxo Bank, said the divergence underscores silver’s vulnerability relative to gold, and that further liquidation by technically driven funds could open the door to the mid-$40s. Platinum dropped 4% to its lowest since September 2025 and palladium fell 3.1% to a June 2025 low.

Miners: almost $140 billion gone from the top five

Gold and silver producers fell further than the metals themselves on Friday, extending a slide that has left most of the sector a third or more below the highs set earlier this year and that knocked $264 billion off the world’s 50 largest miners in the third quarter.

Newmont, the world’s largest gold miner, dropped 5% by late morning in New York, cutting its market value to $110 billion and leaving the stock more than 20% below its 52-week high. Agnico Eagle Mines lost 6.7% to a $83 billion valuation and Barrick Mining fell 5% to $60 billion, with both now roughly a third off their peaks and Barrick down almost 16% for the year. Wheaton Precious Metals, the largest of the streaming companies, lost 5.1% and trades 30% below its high, while Franco-Nevada, down 2.2%, held up best of the group and sits 21% off its peak.

Kinross Gold was the worst of the majors, sliding 7.7% to the edge of its 52-week low. The Toronto-based company has shed 17% in October alone, has lost half its value from its high and is now worth $23 billion. Alamos Gold, down 5.2% a day after delaying a shaft at its Island Gold mine as costs rise , is also trading at a 52-week low and roughly half its peak, while Harmony Gold fell 7%, Gold Fields 6% and AngloGold Ashanti 5.8%, all three now about 40% below their highs. Eldorado Gold lost 4%, adding to Thursday’s drop on an 18% cut to its gold outlook .

Together, Newmont, Agnico, Barrick, Wheaton and Franco-Nevada, North America’s five most valuable gold companies, have lost almost $140 billion in combined market value from their 52-week highs, with Agnico alone accounting for more than $40 billion of that.

Silver producers have been hit hardest. Hecla Mining fell 6% on Friday and has lost 60% from its 52-week high, taking its market capitalization down to $9 billion. Coeur Mining dropped 6.2% to a $13.5 billion valuation, down 25% in October and 53% from its peak, and First Majestic Silver, down 6%, has lost more than half its value from its high. Pan American Silver fell 6.3%, leaving the Vancouver-based miner worth $16 billion and 44% below its high.

The damage is uneven over a longer horizon. Newmont is still up a third over the past 12 months and Barrick 15%, but Kinross is down 14% from a year ago, and Coeur 28%.

(With files from Reuters and Bloomberg)

Oct 30 : Former Ireland international and Wrexham captain James McClean is a free agent after parting ways with hometown club Derry City on Wednesday and, though he is not done with soccer, his next sporting appearance may be in boxing rather than football. 
The combative 37-year-old, who made his name with Sunderland and West Bromwich Albion and has more than 100 caps, is a boxing fanatic and told Reuters that he wanted to take on British TV star Joey Essex in a bout for the Misfits promotion. 
The former Premier League player was speaking to Reuters following the publication of his autobiography, "The Walls". 
Known for his direct, no-nonsense style and competitive fire as a footballer, McClean has boxed for years as part of a daily training schedule that keeps him fit physically and mentally. He is relishing the chance to test his skills in the ring.

"Sparring is great, pads are great, bags are great, but there's only one way to find out (how good I am), and that's stepping in the ring," he said. 
"Boxing's new to me, so of course there's something I want to prove for myself because it's not something that I've excelled at before ... if that is what's next then, obviously, it's exciting."
Having devoted his life to football, McClean is well aware that he does not have the time to start at the bottom of the boxing ladder and work his way up.
The recent surge in "influencer boxing", where everyone from high-profile social media figures to reality TV stars meet in the ring, means it is an attractive option. 
"I'm almost 38 soon so for me to start a professional boxing career and go down that route, starting from scratch, it's just not plausible, given my age and having to do that," he said.
"It (influencer boxing) gives you the opportunity to fight people who aren't pro boxers and they make a decent earning on a couple of fights that probably most professional fighters never make throughout their whole career."
McClean has already been in the celebrity spotlight.
After he moved to Wrexham, owned by Hollywood stars Rob McElhenney and Ryan Reynolds, McClean featured in the reality TV series "Welcome to Wrexham" as the Welsh club won successive promotions to the second-tier Championship.
"If I never kick a ball again, that's where I'll see the ending of my football career. And what a way to go - I'm from Derry but I actually see that club, because of the bond that we had, as kind of my adopted home, it's unbelievable," he said.
McClean returned to Derry City in January after leaving Wrexham but the termination of his contract by mutual consent means he might make that ring walk sooner rather than later. 
"I'm happy now in the last 24 hours because I'm a free man, and for the first time in 20 years, I'm excited about what's next because I can decide what I want to do, and I'm not tied to football or anything else," he added.

Source: Reuters

LONDON, Oct 30 : Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta said teenager Max Dowman must learn to cope with the demands of elite football after the winger's red card in the League Cup defeat at fourth-tier Fleetwood Town, with the 16-year-old having to serve a three-match suspension.
Dowman, who will miss Sunday's Premier League trip to Liverpool, was sent off in the 85th minute of Tuesday's fourth-round loss after an altercation with defender Harrison Neal as Arsenal lost 5-3 on penalties following a 1-1 draw.
"This is the environment, this is the reality. We are not in Disneyland, we are in the Premier League," Arteta told a press conference on Friday following criticism from football fans over his reaction to Dowman after the red card.
Arteta gave the teenager a stern look as he left the pitch at Fleetwood's Highbury Stadium and exchanged words with Dowman on his way down the tunnel, later saying that the issue was something the pair had spoken about before kickoff.

"We look after him so much but at the same time we're going to demand from him like everybody else because he needs to earn the right to play. Because the other boys, what are they going to say to me? You need to be fair," Arteta said.
Arteta said his response was driven by frustration over the consequences for Dowman, adding that the teenager's profile meant he was likely to attract attention from opponents. He dismissed any suggestion of a rift with the winger.
"There are no issues. We had a talk yesterday. I have done it. That's why I am so protective of these things, especially with young players because we have made these mistakes and you know how much you can get punished and how much it can change what happens next," Arteta said.
The Spaniard also voiced his disappointment after an independent regulatory commission upheld Dowman's ban, rejecting Arsenal's appeal against the dismissal and punishment.
"Very disappointed, to be fair, especially with the reckless tackle that he received. His reaction is minimal compared to the action," he said of Neal's challenge on Dowman.
RICE AND CALAFIORI BACK IN TRAINING
On the injury front, Arteta said midfielder Declan Rice and defender Riccardo Calafiori had resumed training after missing the Fleetwood match with issues suffered in last weekend's home win over Everton in the Premier League.
Bukayo Saka, however, remains sidelined with the thigh problem he picked up in the Champions League draw at Bayern Munich on October 21.
"He needed another scan to see how much of the fluid has resolved. Afterwards we'll know more about it," Arteta added.
He also spoke about facing his former teammate Andoni Iraola's side in a "big game" as Arsenal look to claim their first win against Liverpool at Anfield since September 2012.
The two managers are from the Basque region and played together for youth team Antiguoko in San Sebastien.
"It’s a privilege. Someone who has been your teammate, that you spent so many beautiful moments together when we were younger. To be facing each other, to be close, massive clubs in this country, in Europe, in a big match like this, it’s a blessing," he said.
Champions Arsenal are second behind Manchester City on goal difference with 21 points from eight games, six points ahead of fourth-placed Liverpool.
"We expect a big game on Sunday; we’re looking forward to it for sure. It’s been 14 years since we last won there, so it’s time to do it," added Arteta.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Oct 30 : Liverpool coach Andoni Iraola refused to let a five-match winning run go to his team's head on Friday, saying it was too early to discuss a Premier League title challenge before champions Arsenal visit Anfield on Sunday.
After a humbling 3-0 defeat by Manchester City this month, Iraola's side have won five straight games across three competitions, including Wednesday's penalty shootout victory over Chelsea to reach the League Cup quarter-finals.
Fourth-placed Liverpool are six points behind Arsenal.
"It's still October, take one game at a time and I always say the first reference is normally when we have played against each other once, halfway through the season, and then you can start looking at the standings," Iraola told reporters.

"Now we are in a position where we need to improve, keep getting better. Can fans dream? It's good if they have expectations and think we can win. But if you ask me, it is still early."
GOOD RECORD AGAINST ARSENAL 
Iraola has a good record against Arsenal having won three of his last four meetings with Mikel Arteta's side as Bournemouth head coach.
With Arsenal chasing a first win at Anfield since 2012, the Spaniard said past records would count for little.
"It is true we had good results against them with Bournemouth but it does not mean a lot as it is a totally different team, different group of players, different moments," he said.
"At the end of the day it is about winning the duels, running more than them, winning the aerial duels, set plays, mini games, these things that you have to control against Arsenal. They are the champions, they are top of the league right now, they have only lost one game this season."
Sunday's match offers Iraola the chance to meet up with his former teammate Arteta after they came through the youth ranks together in San Sebastian in Spain's Basque Country.
"Last week was (Chelsea boss) Xabi (Alonso), now Mikel, a lot of former friends on the opposition bench lately. I think it is a good thing in terms of spending 5-10 minutes after the game normally with them," Iraola said.
Dominik Szoboszlai (hamstring) and Victor Munoz (knee) could feature after recovering from injuries.

items.author: ロイター

items.summary:
Christina Amann　Rachel More

[ベルリン ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Christina Amann　Rachel More

[ベルリン ３０日 ロイター] - ロイターが３０日に入手したメモによると、事業再編を進める独自動車大手フォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）は、完全電気自動車（ＥＶ）「Ｇｏｌｆ（ゴルフ）」の開発を一時停止する。コスト削減が、本社にある工場で開発中の将来の主力モデルの一つに及んだ形だ。

ブランドの責任者であるトーマス・シェーファー氏は「決定は容易なものではなかった」とした上で、「現時点で開発に資金を充てる余裕がない」と説明した。

当初の発売目標から既に遅れているものの、ロイターが確認した別のメールによると、開発の一時停止による発売の遅れはないという。

ＶＷは１０万人の人員削減やドイツ内の最大４カ所の工場閉鎖を進めている。２０２６年７─９月期決算で営業損失は過去１０年余りで最も大きかった。

メモによると、ニーダーザクセン州にある本社の工場は、コスト削減目標に対し３億ユーロ（３億３６００万ドル）が不足。工場閉鎖の対象ではないものの、ドイツでの事業に対してコスト削減圧力が強まっている。

産業別労働組合ＩＧメタルとの緊張が高まっており、年明けにスト入りの可能性がある。ＶＷ傘下のアウディによる４０億ドル規模の米国での工場建設計画が、監査役会の承認前にトランプ米大統領参加の集会で発表されたことにも反発が起きていた。

産業別労働組合ＩＧメタルとの緊張が高まっており、年明けにスト入りの可能性がある。ＶＷ傘下のアウディによる４０億ドル規模の米国での工場建設計画が、監査役会の承認前にトランプ米大統領参加の集会で発表されたことにも反発が起きていた。

items.author: ロイター

[キーウ　３０日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Dan Peleschuk

[キーウ　３０日　ロイター] - ロシア支配下にあるウクライナ南部オレシュキに３０日、食料や医薬品などの支援物資を積んだ車両が到着し、ロシア・ウクライナの共同救援活動の一環として、一部の住民の退避が認められた。

ウクライナのデービッド・アラハミア議員の投稿によると、トランプ米大統領のメラニア夫人が仲介した局地的停戦の下、支援物資を積んだ車列がオレシュキに到着し、一部の住民はウクライナ支配地域を目指してロシア南部アナパに向けて出発したという。同氏によると、住民はその後ベラルーシに空路で移動し、バスでウクライナに戻るという。 

こうした取り組みは、開戦から４年８カ月で初めてとなる。ただ、ロシアのプーチン大統領の報道官は、これを和平に向けた広範な取り組みに「当てはめるのは難しい」との見方を示した。

これに先立ち、ロシア紙イズベスチヤは３０日、オレシュキに向け、食料や医薬品などの支援物資を積んだ車両が夜間に出発したと報じていた。 

ただ、他の地域では依然として攻撃が続いており、当局者によると、ウクライナの７つの地域のほか首都キーウや東部ドニプロがロシアの夜間攻撃の標的となった。２９日にはドニプロの鉄道駅へのドローン（無人機）攻撃で少なくとも１５人が死亡した。

Oct 30 : Meta Platforms has settled with a teen plaintiff who accused the company of designing Instagram and Facebook to be addictive, causing her mental health problems and disordered eating, attorneys for the plaintiff said on Friday.
The settlement came after jury selection began on Wednesday for a trial that was slated to test the claims of two teens, identified as S.J. and K.D.B., against Meta and Snapchat parent Snap Inc. Meta had settled with S.J. days before the trial, so Friday's settlement with K.D.B. means the trial is expected to proceed against Snap only.
“We remain committed to improving safety for kids on social media apps and holding tech companies accountable, and we are pleased to have brought this matter to a just resolution on behalf of our client,” Emily Jeffcott, an attorney for K.D.B., said in a statement.
A spokesperson for Meta said settlements, dismissals and trials are part of the process of testing cases like this.

"We will continue to defend ourselves in court, and we stand by our record," the spokesperson said, noting that Meta has been building safety tools for more than a decade.
A spokesperson for Snap did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The trial is the second in Los Angeles state court over claims brought by young people who say they became addicted to social media after Meta, Snap, TikTok and Alphabet's YouTube designed their platforms to encourage compulsive use.
S.J. and K.D.B. had previously settled with TikTok and YouTube.
The case was selected among the thousands of pending lawsuits as a test case, so the jury's verdict could influence how the companies and plaintiffs resolve similar cases.
S.J., a 16-year-old girl from Illinois, and K.D.B., an 18-year-old from Mississippi, say they began using YouTube as early as age 3 and the other platforms around age 9, developing compulsive habits they blame on features such as autoplay and infinite scroll. 
The companies have rejected claims their platforms were designed to addict young people, and say they have taken action to make the apps safe places for young people to express themselves. 
Social media companies face thousands of lawsuits in federal and state courts by individuals, school districts, municipalities and other government entities alleging the companies knowingly sought to addict children to their platforms, contributing to a youth mental health crisis involving anxiety, depression and suicide. 
In the first case to go to trial, which ended in March, a Los Angeles jury found Meta and YouTube had been negligent and awarded a young woman $6 million in damages.
The next two teens whose cases were selected for trials either settled or dropped their claims against the companies.
The first school district chosen for trial settled with all of the companies.
In August, Meta struck settlements worth up to $18 billion with nearly every state and US territory to resolve lawsuits brought by attorneys general over the platforms’ harm to teens and agreed to make changes to how Instagram and Facebook work for teens.
Earlier this month, a New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay a $25 billion penalty after a jury found the company misled Facebook users about the privacy of their data and how it handles hate speech. The company has said it will appeal.

Source: Reuters

Oct 30 : Daniil Medvedev secured a place at the season-ending ATP Finals for the seventh time after overwhelming Adrian Mannarino 6-2 6-3 to reach the Vienna Open semi-finals on Friday.
The 30-year-old Russian, who missed out on the season finale last year after qualifying every year from 2019 to 2024, joined Alexander Zverev, Carlos Alcaraz and Ben Shelton in the eight-man field.
Jannik Sinner has also qualified but will not compete due to injury, leaving four places still available.
Medvedev has enjoyed a resurgent season in which he has surpassed the 50-win mark for the first time since 2023 and claimed four titles.

Medvedev took control early against Mannarino with a break of serve and eased through the opening set.
The former U.S. Open champion broke again at 3-3 in the second set and closed out the match with another break.
Medvedev will next face Alcaraz, who defeated Tommy Paul 6-4 7-6(2).
World number one Alexander Zverev thumped Britain's Arthur Fery 6-0 6-2 in 58 minutes to reach the semi-finals.
Fery, who received treatment from the physio in the closing stages of his second-round win against Lorenzo Musetti on Thursday, appeared to be physically hindered from the first game against Zverev.
The German will next face either Italy's Matteo Berrettini or Australian fifth seed Alex de Minaur.

FAST

Oct 30 : The biggest US technology companies generated record amounts of cash in the first nine months of 2026, yet returned the smallest share of it to shareholders in at least 15 years as surging artificial intelligence spending squeezed share buybacks.
The retreat threatens a long-standing source of support for technology share prices. With companies buying back fewer shares, investors are increasingly dependent on heavy AI investments delivering enough profit growth to justify their valuations.
Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta and Oracle returned 9.3 per cent of the cash their businesses generated as dividends and buybacks in the first three quarters of the year, down from 27.4 per cent a year earlier, a Reuters analysis of LSEG data and companies' financial reports showed.
Operating cash flow actually rose 29 per cent from a year earlier to a record $542.9 billion.

But capital spending, driven by the AI boom, doubled to $556.9 billion, exceeding the cash the five firms generated for the first time in data going back to 2011.
That left them with a combined free cash flow deficit of $14 billion, against a surplus of $143.5 billion a year earlier.
The squeeze has hit buybacks hardest. The five companies cut repurchases 83 per cent to $13.6 billion, from $81.8 billion a year earlier.
BUYBACKS FIRST TO GO
Dividends, which investors treat as a commitment, rose to $37 billion in the first nine months of 2026 from $33.9 billion a year earlier. Buybacks almost disappeared.
Alphabet and Meta have not repurchased a share in 2026, after buying back $66.5 billion in the first nine months of last year. Amazon pays no dividend and has not bought back shares since 2022.

NO END IN SIGHT
Amazon said it still expects about $220 billion of capital spending this year, and the other companies have signalled further increases.

"The current regime may increasingly be characterized by greater equity and debt issuance, a request of capital from investors."

Oct 30 : US forward Christian Pulisic has signed a contract extension with AC Milan through 2031, the Serie A club said on Friday. 
The 28-year-old had spells at Borussia Dortmund and Chelsea before joining Milan in 2023. The American has recorded 44 goals in 141 appearances for the Rossoneri and finished the 2024-25 season as their top scorer. 
"Pulisic's contract extension reflects a shared commitment to building on the progress made together in recent years, with the ambition to keep improving, achieve new milestones and write more memorable chapters in the Club's history," Milan said in a statement. 
Pulisic has represented his country at two World Cups and is a four-times winner of the U.S. Soccer Male Player of the Year. 

Source: Reuters

(Corrects designation of John Bilton in paragraph 8)
By Johann M Cherian and Shashwat Chauhan
Oct 30 : More than $2 trillion in market value is set to be wiped from the tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 this month, as Big Tech earnings intensified investor scrutiny of whether the billions being poured into artificial intelligence can generate returns quickly enough.
The wipeout would amount to slightly more than SpaceX’s entire market value. The index has fallen over 5.8 per cent so far in October as the AI trade ran into turbulence, with hyperscalers Meta Platforms, Alphabet and Amazon.com raising spending forecasts further as they race to expand AI infrastructure.

The prospect of ever-bigger AI outlays has unnerved investors, particularly as rising borrowing costs threaten to make debt-funded investment more expensive and harder to justify.
Here's a roundup of megacap earnings so far, with Apple set to report next week and AI bellwether Nvidia due mid-November.
TECH WIPEOUT
Alphabet suffered its biggest one-day percentage drop on record on Thursday after disappointing results in the core business of search advertising and a massive acceleration in cash burn.
Meta's plans for a record $97.5 billion fund raise heightened concerns about shareholder dilution and whether mounting AI spending could force other Big Tech companies to increasingly tap capital markets.
Microsoft and SpaceX broke from the gloom, with results that showed AI spending starting to pay off.
"It may be that we've overestimated how strong the growth might be, but they're not going negative in aggregate," said John Bilton, global head of strategic research, multi-asset solutions at JPMorgan Asset Management.
"We have an insatiable and growing demand for data."
RISING DEBT PILE
Microsoft is reportedly planning to raise about $25 billion through its first US investment-grade bond sale in more than nine years. Among other hyperscalers, Meta, Amazon and Alphabet have issued hundreds of billions of dollars in bond sales over the past four years, worrying investors about overreliance on the medium for raising capital.
Morgan Stanley forecast capital spending on AI infrastructure overall will surpass a trillion dollars next year.
COST TO INSURE AGAINST DEBT DEFAULT SURGE
AI companies’ growing reliance on debt funding is emerging as a new risk for investors, challenging the view that the companies at the heart of the boom are insulated from macroeconomic pressures.
The concern is spreading beyond stocks to credit markets, where investors are starting to price in the possibility that rising financing costs, combined with slower returns on AI spending, could squeeze companies previously viewed as relatively insulated.
ROBUST REVENUE
Revenue across the "Magnificent Seven" has remained strong since ChatGPT's launch in 2022, showcasing insatiable demand and perhaps why investors were initially willing to back the spending, even as the timeline of payoffs remains uncertain.
Amazon's cloud computing cash cow, Amazon Web Services, continued to accelerate, while Meta offered better-than-expected revenue growth and an upbeat outlook. Microsoft also forecast strong cloud growth in its latest earnings report.
SOARING CAPEX
Big Tech has historically spent heavily on infrastructure to build and expand businesses such as cloud computing, online advertising and e-commerce, but the AI boom has pushed capital expenditure to dizzying levels.
J.P. Morgan expects global AI capex to reach $5.5 trillion by 2030, and sees $900 billion being spent in 2026 alone.
This year's AI capex by Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Oracle and Microsoft would likely equal their cumulative spend since the November 2022 launch of ChatGPT, J.P. Morgan analysts noted.

Source: Reuters

items.title: 米金融政策の方向性は「明快」、問題はペース＝リッチモンド連銀総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Howard Schneider

[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Howard Schneider

[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] - 米リッチモンド地区連銀のバーキン総裁は３０日、インフレ率が高く経済が堅調な中、金融政策の方向性は「明確」だが、今後利上げを進めるペースは未確定との認識を示した。 

バーキン総裁はシリウスＸＭの番組「ビジネス・ブリーフィング」で、ＦＲＢが再び利上げする必要があるかどうかを問われ、「インフレは高く、需要は堅調で、失業率は比較的低い。だから、方向性はかなり単純明快だと思う」と応じた。

その上で「問われるのは、ペースだ。われわれは段階的なアプローチを示唆した。カーブにそれほど遅れておらず、見極める時間を確保したい場合には、段階的な対応が理にかなう」と述べた。

現時点では、担当する大西洋岸中部・南東部地区の企業がコスト圧力の高まりと、そのコストを転嫁する意向の両方を報告しているとし、ＡＩ（人工知能）投資の活況が需要と幅広い品目の価格を押し上げていると指摘。ディーゼル燃料から半導体、熟練労働者の賃金に至るまで「多くのコスト圧力が米企業を襲っている。４─５年にわたるインフレ高進という状況の中で、（値上げの）主張はしやすくなっていると思う」と述べた。

その上で「こうしたインフレの実体験は、ＦＲＢが当然何らかの手を打たない限り、将来のインフレに影響を及ぼす」と語った。

ＦＲＢは今週の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）金利を据え置いたが、新たな政策声明で「より多くの情報の蓄積」が政策の道筋を判断する助けになるとした。多くのアナリストはこの新たな文言を、今後の利上げを示唆するシグナルと受け止めた。インフレは多くの政策当局者の予想より根強く、予想外の鈍化がない限り利上げに向かうとの見方だ。

次の一手は早ければ１２月８─９日のＦＯＭＣで打たれる可能性があり、市場はＦＲＢが追加の０．２５％ポイント利上げを承認すると予想している。

バーキン総裁は２０２６年のＦＯＭＣで投票権を持たないが、２０２７年には投票権を得る。

items.title: ホルムズ海峡でタンカー3隻炎上、「無許可」航路通過中　ＩＲＧＣが発表
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[３０日 ロイター] - イランの精鋭部隊「イスラム革命防衛隊（ＩＲＧＣ）」の海軍は３０日、ホルムズ海峡で「無許可の航路」を通過しようとした石油タンカー３隻が火災を起こし、爆発したと発表した。イラン国営メディアが報じた。 

ＩＲＧＣ海軍は声明で、タンカー３隻のうち１隻は原油２００万バレルを積載しており、機雷に接触したと説明した。

ロイターは、この声明の真偽を直ちに確認できなかった。

イランはまた、ホルムズ海峡東部で米国の無人船を破壊したと表明した。米軍から即時の確認は得られておらず、ロイターも独自にこの報告を検証できなかった。

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 30 : While dinosaurs ate a lot of different things, including each other, fruit long seemed to have been absent from their menu. But scientists now have found fossils of a turkey-sized and toothless dinosaur possessing a parrot-like head that exhibited multiple adaptations for a specialized fruit diet.
This first-known frugivorous dinosaur, named Infernogallus jamesi, lived about 66 million years ago during the Cretaceous Period at the twilight of the age of dinosaurs and displayed traits on its beak and jaws for mashing soft food like fruit. It is known from fossils unearthed in Montana and North Dakota.
The name Infernogallus means "hell chicken," a nod to its bird-like appearance and the fact that its fossils were found in the Hell Creek rock formation, which spans the US states of Montana, North Dakota, South Dakota and Wyoming and has yielded the remains of some of the most famous dinosaurs.
It would have eaten fruit and other soft plants in the subtropical coastal floodplain ecosystem it shared with the likes of apex predator Tyrannosaurus, three-horned herbivore Triceratops and tank-like armored plant-eater Ankylosaurus.

Infernogallus was about 5 feet (1.5 meters) long and weighed around 25 pounds (11.3 kg). While the fossils — one nearly complete skeleton and isolated bones from a jaw and palate — did not reveal feathers, the researchers believe Infernogallus was covered in them, based on fossils of close relatives.
It belonged to a group called theropods that includes T. rex and all the meat-eating dinosaurs, as well as some that took to eating plants and the entire bird lineage.
"This definitely expands the range of lifestyles we thought dinosaurs had, and it shows how adaptable theropods were," said paleontologist Greg Funston of Stony Brook University in New York, lead author of the research published in the journal Nature Communications.
Fruits are the reproductive structures of angiosperms, also called flowering plants. Angiosperms first appeared earlier in the Cretaceous, around 130 to 140 million years ago, and subsequently took over landscapes previously dominated by plants called gymnosperms like conifers and ginkgoes.
Infernogallus shows that some dinosaurs may have had a close ecological relationship with flowering plants.
"It has been proposed before that some groups of dinosaurs ate fruits, but there was never evidence to back it up," said study co-author Thomas Dudgeon, a postdoctoral researcher at the Royal Ontario Museum in Toronto.
"The discovery of Infernogallus shows that dinosaur diets were likely far more diverse than we previously thought. Prior to this discovery, there was a bit of a mystery in dinosaur evolution. The evolution of flowering plants introduced a brand-new food source that undoubtedly had consequences for the animals living alongside them," Dudgeon said.
The fruit available for Infernogallus may have included various berries as well as drupes, a broad category that today includes types with a central pit like peaches and cherries as well as others like mangoes and olives.
THREE KEY FEATURES
Infernogallus showed a range of features indicating a frugivorous diet. The three most important, Funston said, were the organization of jaw muscles that powered back-and-forth chewing motions, a mobile joint that enabled the jaw to slide forward, and a series of ridges and grooves on the beak to help mash and shear soft plants like fruits.
"We see these features separately in birds and turtles today that eat soft foods, like the fig-eating vulturine parrot or green sea turtles that chew soft sea grass. But no living animal has all three adaptations, showing just how specialized Infernogallus was," Funston said.
Infernogallus also shows how adaptable beaks are compared to teeth.
"Once you've lost your teeth and developed a beak instead, the range of foods available dramatically increases, including plants, as long as you have some way to digest them," Funston said.
Most herbivorous theropods used stomach stones called gastroliths to grind food. But Infernogallus and other members of a lineage called caenagnathids chewed their food instead.
Fruit-eating animals play an important role for angiosperms by dispersing seeds.
"Mammals and birds would probably also have eaten fruit, but they didn't show the same kinds of specializations for a frugivorous diet that Infernogallus does, so it might have been a less important resource for them. Mammals and birds also were quite small in the Cretaceous, so it's unlikely that they were spreading very large seeds, or that they were spreading them big distances," Funston said.
"We know that these big-seeded fruits were proliferating and spreading, and it seems like caenagnathids could have fit this role — although we feel more evidence is needed before drawing that link confidently," Funston said.

Source: Reuters

items.summary:
[３０日 ロイター] - ３０日の米国株式市場はハイテク株中心のナスダック総合が２カ月超ぶりの安値で寄り付いた。アマゾン・ドット・コムの積極的な人工知能（ＡＩ）投資計画や、半導体大手インテルが示したキャッシュフローがマイナスになるとの見通しを受け、ＡＩインフラ構築のコスト膨張とその投資回収時期を巡る懸念が強まった。  

ナスダック総合は２．２６％下落。Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種も１．１６％安となった。一方、ダウ工業株３０種は０．０８％の小幅高で推移した。

アマゾンが２９日発表した第３・四半期決算は、クラウド事業の成長加速が続いた一方、ＡＩ需要の取り込みに向けた積極投資を背景に現金流出が膨らんだ。２０２７年の設備投資が２６年からさらに増加するとの見通しも示した。

インテルも２９日、パソコン（ＰＣ）市場の低迷や生産上の制約、生産能力拡大への多額の投資により、２６年のキャッシュフローがマイナスになるとの見通しを示した。

   終値

Oct 30 : Tencent-backed Kuaishou Technology said on Friday that its unit Beijing Kling has completed a fundraising round of about 19.8 billion yuan ($2.98 billion).
The short-video platform operator will hold two-thirds of the equity and 52.45 per cent of voting rights in the Kling AI maker through its Lucky Labs holding vehicle.
• The fundraise comes after a $2.8 billion raise in July, which drew investors like Alibaba and Tencent, when Kling was valued at $15 billion pre-money
• Kuaishou did not reveal how Kling would use the proceeds

• Among new investors in the latest round: A unit of Hong Kong-listed Kingdee International invested 300 million yuan, Gongqingcheng Junke put in 200 million yuan and a unit of Shanghai-listed MetaX added 100 million yuan
• They partially took over other investors' commitments and received redemption rights
• Kling competes with AI video generation models of OpenAI, Google and TikTok owner ByteDance
• Kling is planning for an IPO next year, Bloomberg News reported earlier this month citing people familiar with the matter
($1 = 6.66 Chinese yuan renminbi)

価格変動の大きいエネルギーと食品を除いたコアインフレ率は２．１％上昇と、９月の２．４％上昇から伸びが鈍化した。

items.title: 米雇用コスト、第3四半期は前期比0.8％上昇　予想と一致
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] - 米労働省が３０日に発表した２０２６年第３・四半期の雇用コスト指数（ＥＣＩ）は前期比で０．８％上昇し、ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想と一致した。賃金の伸び鈍化を背景に第２・四半期の０．９％上昇から鈍化し、労働市場がインフレリスクになる公算が小さいことを示唆した。

第３・四半期は前年同期比で３．４％上昇と、前期と同じ伸びとなった。

労働コストの大部分を占める賃金・給与は０．７％上昇と、前期の０．９％上昇から伸びが鈍化した。前年同期比でも３．１％上昇と、前期の３．２％上昇から鈍化した。インフレ調整後では前年同期比０．６％低下した。前期は０．３％低下していた。

民間部門の賃金・給与は０．８％上昇と、前期の０．９％上昇から伸びが鈍化した。前年同期比では３．１％上昇した。

公的部門（州・地方自治体）の賃金・給与は０．６％上昇。前期は０．９％上昇していた。前年同期比では３．２％上昇した。 

全労働者の福利厚生費は０．９％上昇と、前期の１．０％上昇から小幅鈍化。公的部門の伸びが０．７％上昇と、前期の１．１％上昇から減速したことが抑制の要因となった。民間部門は０．９％上昇と、前期と同じ伸びとなった。福利厚生費全体では前年同期比３．９％上昇した。     

ＢＭＯキャピタル・マーケッツのシニアエコノミスト、プリシラ・ティアガムーシー氏は「労働コストのインフレは正しい方向に進み続けている」と指摘。「消費者物価は依然として高止まりしているが、労働市場がもはや物価上昇圧力の大きな要因ではなくなったという事実は、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）にとって幾分の安心材料となるだろう」と述べた。

items.title: ＥＣＢ当局者、追加利上げの可能性指摘　物価・賃金上昇を警戒
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [フランクフルト ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[フランクフルト ３０日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）当局者は３０日、高インフレの抑制と賃金・物価の相互加速を防ぐため、追加利上げが必要になる可能性があるとの見方を示した。

ＥＣＢは前日の理事会で利上げを議論したが、エネルギー価格主導のインフレ急進が危険な二次的波及効果をまだ生んでいないとの判断に基づき、最終的に全会一致で据え置きを決めた。

３０日の当局者発言からは、利上げが先送りされたにすぎず、１２月の利上げがあり得ることを示した。

イタリア中央銀行のパネッタ総裁はローマで「物価上昇が家計や企業の期待や行動に定着して食い止めに代償を伴う賃金と物価の上昇スパイラルを引き起こすことを、金融政策は防ぐことができ、また防ぐべきだ」と指摘。「インフレ率が長期にわたり目標を上回る見通しで、リスクも上振れ方向にあることから、政策金利のさらなる引き上げが必要になる可能性がある」と述べた。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、市場は１２月の利上げ確率を約３分の２と見込んでいる。２０２６年にすでに実施された２回の利上げに加え、今後１年間に３回近くの利上げを予想している。

オーストリア中央銀行のコッハー総裁も３０日のブログ投稿でパネッタ氏と同様の見解を示し、「近い将来に状況が改善しなければ、金融政策を取り巻く環境からみて対応が必要になるだろう」と記し、「インフレリスクは明らかに高まった。ただ、時期尚早な行動も、何もせずに待つことも、物価安定を確保することにはならない」とした。

ユーロ圏の９月インフレ率は３．８％と、ＥＣＢの目標のほぼ２倍に達した。エネルギーコストの再急騰と食品価格の上昇により、今後数カ月に一段と加速する可能性がある。

ＥＣＢが３０日に公表した調査によると、インフレ率は２６・２７年に従来予想を上回るペースで加速し、目標に戻るのは２８年になる可能性がある。

エストニア中央銀行のカーシク総裁は「物価上昇が予想よりも速く、長期にわたって続くリスクは依然として大きい」と指摘。「したがって、金融市場がＥＣＢの追加利上げを見込んでいることは理解できる」と語った。

一方、パネッタ氏は慎重な姿勢も示し、ＥＣＢは「金融政策を段階的に調整する」際、最近の債券利回りの急上昇がすでに借り入れコストを押し上げていることを考慮すべきだと述べた。

Gone in 20 minutes: How the biggest heist in crypto history unfolded

"The attacker may not have stolen the vault key, they may have hijacked the system that tells the vault to release money," says a lawyer who works on crypto cases. 

Binance logo and hacker code are seen in this illustration taken October 30, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

FAST

SINGAPORE: Hackers stole US$6.3 billion from Binance , the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange, in a record digital asset theft.
WHAT HAPPENED? About US$6.3 billion of cryptocurrencies were drained from wallets that Binance uses to process transactions, according to the exchange and expert analysis of blockchain records.
Binance said in a statement on X that it initially thought the attack involved a compromised laptop. 

"However, our subsequent investigation has uncovered additional points of breach," it added, without elaborating.
The exchange operates a secure asset fund for users, a US$1 billion bitcoin reserve designed to protect customers in the event of a security breach, according to its website.

Subscribe to our Chief Editor’s Week in Review

Our chief editor shares analysis and picks of the week's biggest news every Saturday.

This service is not intended for persons residing in the E.U. By clicking subscribe, I agree to receive news updates and promotional material from Mediacorp and Mediacorp’s partners.

Loading

Co-CEO Richard Teng said losses would be covered by the fund and company resources.
According to US blockchain analytics firm TRM Labs, the attackers compromised Binance's "signing infrastructure", which authorises transactions, allowing them to issue instructions that emptied the affected wallets.
The bulk of the heist unfolded in about 20 minutes, blockchain records show, beginning shortly after 8pm GMT (4am, Friday, Singapore time) on Thursday (Oct 29).
Once the funds were moved, the attackers raced to shift them beyond the reach of Binance counterparties and stablecoin issuers, which have frozen roughly half of the stolen assets.
An unusual feature of some cryptocurrencies, including major stablecoins such as Tether's USDT and Circle's USDC, is that their issuers can freeze them remotely.
"In layman's terms, the attacker may not have stolen the vault key, they may have hijacked the system that tells the vault to release money," said Joshua Chu, a Hong Kong lawyer who works on crypto cases. 
WHO IS BEHIND IT?  Several US blockchain analysis firms said the attack bears similarities to previous operations attributed to North Korean hackers.
Teng said Binance's investigation had not yet identified the attackers, while North Korea routinely denies involvement in cyberattacks and cryptocurrency thefts. North Korea's mission in Geneva and embassy in China did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
TRM said the breach shared characteristics with last year's attack on crypto exchange Bybit, which the FBI attributed to North Korean hackers. The firm said it was highly confident the same group was behind the Binance theft.
Chainalysis said funds stolen in an attack last month on Bitget were being mixed with proceeds from the Binance breach.

Related:

Hackers allegedly from North Korea steal US$6.3 billion from Binance in world's biggest crypto heist

WHERE'S THE MONEY? About half the stolen assets were stablecoins that have since been frozen by issuers including Tether, Circle, Ripple and World Liberty Financial, the Trump family's crypto venture.
That doesn't mean the coins will be returned to Binance, but it significantly limits the attackers' ability to convert them into cash.
TRM said some of the funds had already been posted as collateral to borrow ether and estimated that about US$2.4 billion worth of bitcoin and ether is beyond reach.
"No company issues bitcoin or ether and no company can freeze either one," said Patrick Tan, general counsel of ChainArgos, a blockchain intelligence firm in Singapore.
"The bitcoin and ether can be stopped only if the attacker sends them to a crypto-asset exchange or broker that is able and willing to freeze them, or if law enforcement obtains the private keys."
Market participants said the attackers would likely mix the stolen coins with other assets or use lesser known coins and exchanges to try to move the proceeds.
"The more time passes, the less likely they will be able to fold those funds into other exchanges or payment providers — they essentially get blacklisted," said Bernardo Brites, CEO of Trace Finance, a stablecoin infrastructure company.
"In reality a lot of the proceeds of hacks ... (can only be laundered) in the first few hours, but after that happens, you have a lot of different players who know those are marked funds ... and they usually sit there for years."
WHAT NEXT? The theft is the latest in a series of major digital asset breaches. Attackers stole US$2.9 billion of cryptocurrency across nearly 150 incidents last year, according to TRM Labs.
The attack has also rattled confidence in the sector. Cryptocurrencies fell on Friday and the total market value of stablecoins declined, suggesting investors were pulling money from digital assets.

Source: Reuters/rj

LONDON, Oct 30 : Binance is working with law enforcement around the world, including the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) and the United States Secret Service (USSS), after hackers stole a record $6.3 billion from the platform, a person familiar with the situation told Reuters.
The FBI said in a statement that it was "aware of the incident and is engaged with relevant public and private partners to understand the scope of the activity, evaluate potential impacts, and coordinate appropriate investigative steps." 
The USSS did not respond to a request for comment sent via email outside of US hours.

items.title: ユーロ圏ＧＤＰ、第3四半期速報は予想上回る0.4％増　失業率6.5％
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Balazs Koranyi

[フランクフルト ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Balazs Koranyi

[フランクフルト ３０日 ロイター] -  欧州連合（ＥＵ）統計局（ユーロスタット）が３０日発表した第３・四半期のユーロ圏域内総生産（ＧＤＰ）速報値は、前期比０．４％増と、市場予想を上回った。投資と消費が堅調で、エネルギー高の逆風にもかかわらず底堅さを示したが、借り入れコストの急上昇と急速なインフレが先行きに影を落としている。 

非常に高い伸びとなった第２・四半期の０．６％から減速したものの、ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想の０．２％を上回った。

前年同期比では１．３％増と、予想の１．１％を上回った。潜在成長率とおおむね同水準だった。

人工知能（ＡＩ）、防衛、インフラへの多額の支出が投資を押し上げ、堅調な外需が産業を支えた。家計も高水準にある貯蓄率を引き下げながら消費を続けた。

国別では、ドイツが前期比０．２％増、スペインとオランダがそれぞれ０．６％増だった。イタリアは横ばいで、フランスは０．１％のマイナス成長となった。

ユーロ圏の成長率は米国の半分にも満たないが、イラン戦争が始まった後に示された悲観的な予測をなお大幅に上回っている。

アイルランドの前期比５．５％という突出した伸びにユーロ圏全体の成長率が押し上げられた面もある。

ユーロ圏の主要国の大半で１０月に物価上昇が加速しており、域内全体の前年比インフレ率は３．９％以上に跳ね上がる可能性がある。ＥＣＢの目標である２％を大幅に上回る水準だ。こうした数字になれば、すでに市場で広がっている１２月の追加利上げ観測が一段と強まる。

追加利上げは成長をさらに抑制するが、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が３０日に公表した調査では、インフレ期待が大幅に上昇しており物価上昇率が目標に戻るのは２８年になる可能性が示された。ＥＣＢ当局者も追加利上げの可能性を指摘した。 

しかし経済指標は高インフレがまだ二次的波及効果を生んでいないことを示している。労働市場が比較的軟調なためとみられる。

８月の失業率は６．５％で横ばいだった。ただ、過去１年の大半にわたり緩やかに上昇しており、２４年終盤に記録した過去最低の６．２％を上回っている。

ユーロ圏の主要国の大半で１０月に物価上昇が加速しており、域内全体の前年比インフレ率は３．９％以上に跳ね上がる可能性がある。ＥＣＢの目標である２％を大幅に上回る水準だ。こうした数字になれば、すでに市場で広がっている１２月の追加利上げ観測が一段と強まる。

追加利上げは成長をさらに抑制するが、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が３０日に公表した調査では、インフレ期待が大幅に上昇しており物価上昇率が目標に戻るのは２８年になる可能性が示された。ＥＣＢ当局者も追加利上げの可能性を指摘した。 

しかし経済指標は高インフレがまだ二次的波及効果を生んでいないことを示している。労働市場が比較的軟調なためとみられる。

８月の失業率は６．５％で横ばいだった。ただ、過去１年の大半にわたり緩やかに上昇しており、２４年終盤に記録した過去最低の６．２％を上回っている。

Oct 30 : Global equity funds saw substantial inflows in the week ended October 28, though at a slower pace, as a rebound in AI and chip stocks, led by South Korea’s SK Hynix after record quarterly profit, lifted demand for technology and Asian funds.
Investors bought a net $10.19 billion in global equity funds for a sixth consecutive week of net purchases, though inflows eased from $25.06 billion the previous week, according to LSEG Lipper data.
There was, however, some caution in markets over the AI trade ahead of earnings reports from AI hyperscalers Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon.
Asian equity funds led regional inflows, attracting $9.9 billion in net purchases, after $11.58 billion the previous week. Investors added $4.54 billion to European funds but withdrew a net $6.65 billion from US equity funds.

Oct 30 : Hackers stole $6.3 billion from Binance in the world's biggest crypto heist, putting a spotlight on how cryptocurrency exchanges insure their digital assets against theft and cyberattacks.
But insurance protection is far from uniform. Coverage depends on how assets are stored, how hackers gain access and the specific terms of the policy.
Limited regulation and volatile crypto prices have long made insurers wary of the sector, despite growing demand for protection against digital asset theft and claims against company executives.
While both crime and demand for protection have tracked cryptocurrencies' meteoric rise, underwriting such risks remains a niche business offered largely by specialist insurers in the Lloyd's market and in Bermuda.

WHAT IS DIGITAL ASSET INSURANCE?
Digital asset insurance is a range of policies designed to protect cryptocurrency exchanges, custodians and other companies operating in the sector against financial losses arising from the theft of digital assets, cyberattacks, technology failures and other business risks.
Unlike traditional insurance, these policies are tailored to risks associated with blockchain technology, including the theft or loss of private keys, wallet security breaches, smart contract vulnerabilities and failures in digital asset custody.
The global crypto insurance market was valued at $9.37 billion in 2025 and is projected to reach $184.98 billion by 2033, according to Data Bridge Market Research.
The research firm cited growing institutional adoption of cryptocurrencies and rising incidents of cyberattacks and digital asset theft among the factors driving demand.
Coverage can include several types of policies:
• Crime insurance for theft, social engineering and scams
• Cyber liability for breaches, hacks and regulatory response
• Errors and omissions insurance for software bugs, smart contract failures
• Directors and officers insurance for lawsuits targeting executives
• Technology liability for infrastructure providers
HOW ARE LOSSES COVERED?
When a crypto exchange suffers a hack, losses can be covered through a combination of insurance payouts, the company's own capital and emergency funds set aside to compensate customers.
The extent of insurance coverage depends on the policies held by the exchange, including their limits, deductibles and exclusions. Where losses exceed the insured amount, the company must rely on its own financial resources or other recovery arrangements to meet its obligations.
Some exchanges also maintain reserve funds to reimburse customers following security breaches. Binance established the Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU) in July 2018 as an emergency reserve to protect users in extreme cases, such as security breaches or platform-level incidents.
As of 2026, the SAFU fund holds crypto assets worth roughly $1 billion, entirely in bitcoin, according to Binance's website. The company did not immediately respond to Reuters' request for comment on its insurance coverage.
WHAT CAN PREVENT AN INSURANCE PAYOUT?
Exclusions that allow insurers to deny certain claims are common in policies covering digital assets as well as the personal liabilities of directors and officers at cryptocurrency companies. These can limit the scope of protection available to companies and make it harder for them to secure coverage.
Common exclusions in these policies include value fluctuations, fraudulent acts by the policyholder and unsecured or negligent key management.
"Digital asset firms and, increasingly, their institutional clients need to understand precisely what is covered, where exclusions and sublimits apply, and which risks are retained," Jacqueline Quintal, Marsh's financial institutions and digital asset industry leader, told Reuters.
"Given the potential gap between probable/possible loss and available insurance capacity, technology and security controls, strong governance and financial strength are equally important to resilience."
DO TRADITIONAL CRIME AND CYBER INSURANCE POLICIES COVER CRYPTO?
Most standard crime insurance policies do not cover cryptocurrency losses, as they were originally designed to protect physical property such as cash, securities and precious metals.
Traditional cyber liability policies also do not always cover the value of digital assets stolen in a hack. While cyber policies can cover both first-party losses and third-party liabilities, including forensic investigations, customer notifications and legal expenses, they generally exclude the loss or transfer of funds.
As a result, standalone cyber policies typically do not cover the full value of stolen cryptocurrency unless specific digital asset coverage has been added.
HOW DO INSURERS ASSESS CRYPTO THEFT CLAIMS?
Insurers examine how a breach occurred, which systems were compromised and whether the resulting loss falls within the policy's coverage.
They may also assess whether the exchange followed required security procedures, including controls over private keys, wallet access and transaction approvals.
The distinction between an external hacker stealing credentials and an employee deliberately transferring assets can determine whether a crime or cyber insurance policy covers the loss.

Source: Reuters

Oct 30 : Reddit shares tumbled 29 per cent on Friday, marking their biggest single-day drop and hitting their lowest level in over a year, after the company warned that Google's AI-powered search was hurting referral traffic and could shrink its user base.
The online discussion platform still appears in Google search results but is attracting fewer clicks, as users increasingly rely on the tech giant's AI tools for direct answers.
"When more than a million search referrals a week disappear because Google's AI answers the question itself, investors are no longer looking just at the next three or four months, but at how much of Reddit's audience it will really own in the years ahead," said Vitor Madeira, senior market specialist at Capital.com.
Reddit warned that its daily active unique visitors could fall by a low double-digit percentage in the fourth quarter if referral traffic kept declining.

The trend is also hitting other businesses, including news publishers, educational platforms such as Chegg and travel and product-review sites.
Meanwhile, shares of rival Pinterest fell nearly 8 per cent after it missed analysts' estimates for third-quarter revenue and profit, and forecast revenue for the crucial holiday quarter below estimates.
If current losses hold, Reddit is set to lose more than $7 billion in market value and Pinterest about $900 million. The two stocks have fallen about 44 per cent and 23 per cent, respectively, this year through their last close.
Reddit has a 12-month forward price-to-earnings ratio of 19.03, compared with Snap's 7.53 and Pinterest's 8.48, according to LSEG data.
Separately, Reddit on Friday said it has extended its cloud services agreement with Google through 2029, committing to spend $580 million over three years.
Google is also facing questions about monetization of AI-powered search, after growth in search revenue slowed to 12 per cent in the September quarter, sending Alphabet shares tumbling and wiping about $500 billion off its market value on Thursday.
At least 11 brokerages cut their price targets on Reddit, and at least 13 did so on Pinterest.

Oct 30 : Hong Kong flagship carrier Cathay Pacific Airways said on Friday a data security breach at the Spanish software provider Amadeus affected around 53,000 bookings, though its own systems and operations were unaffected.
Cathay joins other airlines, including Japan Airlines and South Korea's Asiana Airlines, that recently flagged customer data was compromised in the Amadeus breach.

• Cathay Pacific said the breach affected bookings from August 2023 to September, citing Amadeus data, and added there was "no evidence that financial or payment information was accessed"

Oct 30 : Intel tumbled 29 per cent on Friday and was on track for its sharpest one-day decline, deepening a broader retreat in technology stocks as investors grew increasingly wary of weakening PC demand and the vast spending required to build out AI infrastructure.
The steep fall put the US chipmaker on track to shed more than $137 billion in market value, underscoring the challenges facing CEO Lip-Bu Tan's turnaround as a prolonged PC slump offsets heavy investments in AI and manufacturing expansion.
Semiconductor stocks, including Advanced Micro Devices, Arm Holdings, Qualcomm, Nvidia, Broadcom and Micron, fell between 2 per cent and 10 per cent.
"The market is in a sell first, ask questions later mood right now, and Intel's warning has given investors an easy excuse to take some money off the table across chip stocks," said Matt Britzman, senior equity analyst, Hargreaves Lansdown.

The selloff spread to server makers, reflecting investor caution toward companies tied to the semiconductor and AI infrastructure supply chain.
Shares of server makers Dell Technologies, Hewlett Packard Enterprise and Super Micro Computer fell between 6 per cent and 10 per cent.
The STOXX Europe 600 Technology Index fell 2 per cent, with sector heavyweight ASML shedding 4.6 per cent. US-listed shares of TSMC, the world's largest contract chipmaker, fell 3.3 per cent.
Intel forecast fourth-quarter revenue of $15 billion to $16 billion, below analysts' average estimate of $17.07 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG.
Finance chief David Zinsner also said Intel does not expect positive cash flow this year.
MEMORY CRUNCH BITES
Higher memory prices, driven by suppliers shifting capacity toward AI-focused high-bandwidth memory chips, are raising PC costs and weighing on already weak consumer demand.
PC chips accounted for roughly half of Intel's third-quarter revenue, and the company expects sales from the segment to decline more than 20 per cent sequentially this quarter after a 5 per cent drop in the September period.
"It will be important to see if Intel can expand the highly profitable Xeon product supply to help offset this developing weakness in PC," said Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management.
"Bottom line, weaker sales volumes, higher manufacturing costs, and an out-of-cycle product mix is a recipe for the stock to decline over the near term as future earnings are under a lot of pressure."

items.title: 中国軍、スカボロー礁で戦闘即応パトロール　フィリピンに対抗
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [北京 ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[北京 ３０日 ロイター] - 中国軍は３０日、南シナ海で中国とフィリピンの長年の対立の火種となっているスカボロー礁（中国名・黄岩島）周辺で、海空軍が戦闘即応パトロールを実施したと発表した。

人民解放軍南部戦区は声明で、パトロールは「フィリピンによる権益侵害と挑発行為への必要な対抗措置」だとし、１０月に入ってこうしたパトロールを強化していると説明した。

「こうしたパトロールは関連海域・空域の管理と統制をさらに強化することを目的としており、あらゆる権益侵害や挑発行為に対処する有効な対抗措置となる」と述べた。

中国海警局も３０日、スカボロー礁周辺の海域で法執行のためのパトロールを別途実施し、「フィリピンによる権益侵害と挑発行為への必要な対抗措置」だとした。

中国軍と中国海警局はともに、フィリピンのどの行動を指しているのか、詳細を明らかにしなかった。

items.title: 中国・スイス首脳、貿易協定改定を歓迎　保護主義の流れに逆行
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [北京 ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[北京 ３０日 ロイター] - 中国の習近平国家主席とスイスのパルムラン大統領は３０日、両国の貿易協定の改定を歓迎した。世界的に保護主義が広がる中、流れに逆行する動きとなる。

協定は３０日に署名される予定で、スイスに対し中国市場への参入を異例の水準まで自由化する。

パルムラン氏は「両国関係の新たな一歩であり、交渉の成果を誇ってよいと思う。企業や他の関係者の具体的な期待に応えた」と述べた。両国の外相による次回の戦略対話を年内に開きたいとの意向も示した。

習氏は、今回の協定は開かれた協力関係を守る政治的勇気と責任感を示すものだと評価した。両国が力を合わせれば、中国と欧州の貿易協力や世界経済の発展に、より大きな確実性をもたらすことができると述べた。

LONDON, Oct 30 : Britain's competition regulator on Friday said it has opened an investigation into whether Meta was imposing exploitative terms on publishers and advertisers to use their content to develop its own services, including its AI features.
The CMA said Facebook parent Meta's commercial terms could allow it to collect content from publishers' websites and use it to develop and provide its own products and services without businesses getting a choice on if or how their content is used.
The watchdog said that the terms, which it said Meta planned to revise on November 20 but has since put on hold, could amount to an unlawful imposition of unfair trading conditions.
The CMA's investigation will determine whether Meta holds a dominant position in a relevant UK market and, if so, whether the terms amount to abuse of that position.
Meta said there were "no grounds" for an investigation.
"We've already committed not to change our terms without consulting publishers and other stakeholders," a Meta spokesperson said. "We welcome the opportunity to explain our approach to the CMA."

Source: Reuters

items.title: 中国人民銀、翌日物リバースレポ操作を毎日実施　主要政策金利へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [北京／上海 ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[北京／上海 ３０日 ロイター] - 中国人民銀行（中央銀行）は３０日、１１月２日から毎営業日、翌日物リバースレポ操作を実施すると発表した。すでに示している翌日物リバースレポ金利を主要政策金利に位置付けるための一歩となる。

人民銀は声明で、各営業日に固定金利の数量入札方式を通じて翌日物の公開市場操作（オペ）を実施するとした。現在のオペレートレートは１．２５％という。

人民銀は１０月に方針転換を示しており、短期金利の管理をさらに改善することを目的としていると説明した。７日物リバースレポ操作は、固定数量で複数の落札金利を認める金利入札方式に移行し、主に納税期や月末の前後に実施するという。

これまで７日物リバースレポ金利を基準として、その上下のスプレッドで価格設定されていたその他の手段（一時的なレポ・リバースレポ操作や、海外の中銀型機関向けレポファシリティーを含む）について、今後は翌日物リバースレポ金利を基準としたスプレッドで価格設定されることになる。スプレッドの幅は変更されない。

国泰君安国際のチーフエコノミスト、周浩氏は「今回の動きは、人民銀が米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）、日銀など主要中央銀行と同様に、翌日物金利を軸とする金融政策運営の枠組みに移行しつつあることを示す明確なシグナルと言える」と述べた。

中信証券のチーフエコノミストは、短期金利の仕組みの改革は、貸出金利の基準を多様化するとともに、金利全般の低下を貸出金利に波及させるための土台を整えるものだとの見方を示した。

人民銀によると、これまで７日物リバースレポ金利に対し一定の金利差（スプレッド）で適用金利を設定していた一時的レポやリバースレポ操作、海外中央銀行などの機関向けレポファシリティーなどについては、今後は翌日物リバースレポ金利を基準とする。スプレッドの幅は変更されない。

翌日物リバースレポ操作は６月下旬、人民銀の新たな政策手段として導入された。

items.title: アングル：日銀、基調物価2％定着へ利上げ継続　「次の次」は転換点か
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Takahiko Wada

［東京　３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Takahiko Wada

［東京　３０日　ロイター］ - 基調的な物価上昇率の２％到達を表明したことで、日銀は今後、基調物価の２％付近での安定に向け、より機動的な政策運営を行っていくとみられる。物価上振れリスクは依然として無視できず、緩和的な金融環境が続いているとして、当面は利上げ継続方針だが、物価の推移や賃金などの動向次第では０．２５％刻みで次の次となる１．７５％が政策金利の一つの転換点となる可能性がある。

３０日に会見した植田和男総裁は「何かを見ながらじっと待っているのではなく、基調物価が定着していくように適宜金融政策を調整していく」と述べ、情勢次第で機動的に対応していく姿勢を示した。

次の利上げについては、このままの状況で推移すれば１２月もしくは来年１月とみる向きが日銀内でも増えつつある。中東情勢の緊迫化を受けた諸コスト上昇の価格転嫁はさらに進み、全国消費者物価指数（除く生鮮、コアＣＰＩ）の前年比はここからさらに伸び率が拡大すると見込まれている。日銀内には、金融環境が緩和的な中、この状況を放置するだけでも先行きのインフレ圧力になるとの警戒感がある。

決定会合で議論した展望リポートでは、基調物価が「２％目標を超えて上振れていくリスクがある」と改めて指摘した。２％への定着に向けて、基調物価が２％を超えていきそうなリスクが生じれば、早めに対応する必要があるとの声もある。

＜焦点は「次の次」＞

    しかし「次の次」、１．７５％への利上げの是非を巡る議論では日銀内の空気が変化する可能性がある。

背景の１つには物価の見通しがある。来年度にかけて、消費税率引き下げの影響を除いたコアＣＰＩの伸び率は高止まりが続く可能性が意識される一方で、一段と上放れていく可能性は低いとの見方が日銀では出ている。

この日発表の１０月東京都区部ＣＰＩではコアＣＰＩが２．６％上昇となった。中東情勢の緊迫化などによる価格転嫁がさらに進むことで、全国コアＣＰＩの伸び率は「２％をはっきりと上回る水準まで伸び率を高めていく」と日銀はみているが、民間エコノミストからは、コアＣＰＩの伸び率のピークは「２７年春ごろ」（みずほ証券の片木亮介マーケットエコノミスト）との声が出ている。

基調物価を見極める上で重要な賃金の上昇率についても、伸びが加速して物価にさらに反映される「二次的波及」に発展することは考えにくいとの見方が根強い。政府の物価高対策が奏功して、全国ＣＰＩにみる物価上昇率は今年、暦年ベースでは昨年を大幅に下回る伸び率となりそうで、前年より低い物価上昇率は賃上げ加速には結びつかない可能性がある。

植田総裁も会見で、物価上昇率が今年は暦年ベースで「２％を少し下回る可能性がある」とし、春闘の結果への影響を注視していかなければいけないと話した。

日銀は利上げ判断に向け、過去の累次の利上げが金融環境にどう影響するかを注視している。中立金利と整合的な「中立的な金融環境」を規定することは困難で、日銀短観などの指標や金融機関、企業からのヒアリング情報の蓄積を通じ、金融環境の変化を見極めていくしかないとの見方だ。

    基調的な物価上昇率が２％に到達した今、日銀内では、先行きの政策の自由度を確保するために政策金利を早期に中立金利に持っていきたいとの思いがある半面で、金融環境が緩和的ならいつまでも利上げを続けていいわけではなく、累次の利上げによる金融環境や経済への影響も併せてみていく必要があるとの見方もある。

    小枝淳子審議委員は１５日の講演で、中立金利は「１％よりは相応に上」と述べた。２％程度とみている田村直樹審議委員とは見立てに差がある。利上げが進むにつれて、日本の経済・物価の「真の実力」をどうみるのか、デフレに戻るリスクはないのか、政策委員の議論がいっそう活発化するとみられる。

＜「ショックは必ず起きる」＞

    一方、昨年はトランプ関税、今年は米国・イスラエルによるイラン攻撃と、日本の経済・物価は連続でショックに襲われた。今後も何らかのショックは必ず起き、対応が迫られることになるとの声が聞かれる。

    現時点で、日銀は中立金利を大きく上回る水準まで一気に利上げした上で、物価高の沈静を待って段階的に利下げして中立金利に政策金利を持っていく展開は想定していない。しかし、今後のショックの出方次第では、中立金利の推計レンジの真ん中に位置する１．７５％は単なる通過点となる可能性もある。

    政策金利はすでに３１年ぶりの高水準に達している。度重なるショックの中でも日本経済が頑健さを発揮したことで、日銀は累次の利上げを進めることができた。さらなる利上げ判断に当たっては、経済の底堅さが持続するかも条件になる。

この日発表の１０月東京都区部ＣＰＩではコアＣＰＩが２．６％上昇となった。中東情勢の緊迫化などによる価格転嫁がさらに進むことで、全国コアＣＰＩの伸び率は「２％をはっきりと上回る水準まで伸び率を高めていく」と日銀はみているが、民間エコノミストからは、コアＣＰＩの伸び率のピークは「２７年春ごろ」（みずほ証券の片木亮介マーケットエコノミスト）との声が出ている。

基調物価を見極める上で重要な賃金の上昇率についても、伸びが加速して物価にさらに反映される「二次的波及」に発展することは考えにくいとの見方が根強い。政府の物価高対策が奏功して、全国ＣＰＩにみる物価上昇率は今年、暦年ベースでは昨年を大幅に下回る伸び率となりそうで、前年より低い物価上昇率は賃上げ加速には結びつかない可能性がある。

植田総裁も会見で、物価上昇率が今年は暦年ベースで「２％を少し下回る可能性がある」とし、春闘の結果への影響を注視していかなければいけないと話した。

日銀は利上げ判断に向け、過去の累次の利上げが金融環境にどう影響するかを注視している。中立金利と整合的な「中立的な金融環境」を規定することは困難で、日銀短観などの指標や金融機関、企業からのヒアリング情報の蓄積を通じ、金融環境の変化を見極めていくしかないとの見方だ。

    基調的な物価上昇率が２％に到達した今、日銀内では、先行きの政策の自由度を確保するために政策金利を早期に中立金利に持っていきたいとの思いがある半面で、金融環境が緩和的ならいつまでも利上げを続けていいわけではなく、累次の利上げによる金融環境や経済への影響も併せてみていく必要があるとの見方もある。

    小枝淳子審議委員は１５日の講演で、中立金利は「１％よりは相応に上」と述べた。２％程度とみている田村直樹審議委員とは見立てに差がある。利上げが進むにつれて、日本の経済・物価の「真の実力」をどうみるのか、デフレに戻るリスクはないのか、政策委員の議論がいっそう活発化するとみられる。

＜「ショックは必ず起きる」＞

    一方、昨年はトランプ関税、今年は米国・イスラエルによるイラン攻撃と、日本の経済・物価は連続でショックに襲われた。今後も何らかのショックは必ず起き、対応が迫られることになるとの声が聞かれる。

    現時点で、日銀は中立金利を大きく上回る水準まで一気に利上げした上で、物価高の沈静を待って段階的に利下げして中立金利に政策金利を持っていく展開は想定していない。しかし、今後のショックの出方次第では、中立金利の推計レンジの真ん中に位置する１．７５％は単なる通過点となる可能性もある。

    政策金利はすでに３１年ぶりの高水準に達している。度重なるショックの中でも日本経済が頑健さを発揮したことで、日銀は累次の利上げを進めることができた。さらなる利上げ判断に当たっては、経済の底堅さが持続するかも条件になる。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Sheila Dang

[ヒューストン ３０日 ロイター] - 米石油大手エクソンモービルが３０日発表した第３・四半期決算は、利益が市場予想を上回った。米国とイスラエルによる対イラン戦争や、ウクライナによるロシアの製油所への攻撃で精製マージンが急拡大し、利益を押し上げた。

調整後の１株利益は４．２３ドルと、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の４．０８ドルを上回った。

第３・四半期決算の詳細は以下の通り。

• 調整後利益は１７５億ドルとなり、アナリスト予想平均の１６６億ドルを上回った。

• 上流部門の調整後利益は７３億ドルと、前期比２０％減少した。指標となる北海ブレント原油の価格が前期を下回ったことが響いた。

• 中東各地での戦闘とロシア・ウクライナ戦争で燃料の生産設備が稼働できなくなり、世界的に軽油の供給不足が生じている。これに伴う燃料価格の上昇で、欧米の石油大手は軒並み利益が急増した。

• 上流部門の調整後利益は７３億ドルと、前期比２０％減少した。指標となる北海ブレント原油の価格が前期を下回ったことが響いた。

• 特殊製品部門の調整後利益は３２％増の１３億ドルだった。

• 同社は配当として４３億ドルを支払い、５１億ドル相当の自社株買いを実施した。

items.body:
Sheila Dang

[ヒューストン ３０日 ロイター] - 米石油大手シェブロンが３０日発表した第３・四半期決算は、調整後利益が前年同期比１８５％増の１０４億ドル（１株当たり５．２８ドル）となり、１株利益はアナリスト予想の４．８９ドルを上回った。イラン戦争とウクライナ戦争を背景に精製マージンが急上昇した。

詳細は以下の通り。

• 上流部門の利益は５７億ドルで、原油価格の下落が一因となり、前四半期比３０％減少。

• 下流部門の利益は合計４９億ドルで、第２・四半期をわずかに上回った。

• シェブロンの製油所は当四半期に米原油処理量が日量１００万バレルを超え、過去最高を記録。ディーゼル燃料とジェット燃料の生産量も１０％以上増加。

• この四半期には、ベネズエラ事業に持分法を適用した後の１カ月分のベネズエラでの生産が含まれている。

[ヒューストン ３０日 ロイター] - 米石油大手シェブロンが３０日発表した第３・四半期決算は、調整後利益が前年同期比１８５％増の１０４億ドル（１株当たり５．２８ドル）となり、１株利益はアナリスト予想の４．８９ドルを上回った。イラン戦争とウクライナ戦争を背景に精製マージンが急上昇した。

詳細は以下の通り。

• 上流部門の利益は５７億ドルで、原油価格の下落が一因となり、前四半期比３０％減少。

• 下流部門の利益は合計４９億ドルで、第２・四半期をわずかに上回った。

• シェブロンの製油所は当四半期に米原油処理量が日量１００万バレルを超え、過去最高を記録。ディーゼル燃料とジェット燃料の生産量も１０％以上増加。

• この四半期には、ベネズエラ事業に持分法を適用した後の１カ月分のベネズエラでの生産が含まれている。

• ベネズエラからの生産はフリーキャッシュフローがプラスで、総コストは１バレル当たり２０ドル未満だという。

• シェブロンは日量３９８万石油換算バレルを生産。前四半期比で２％減少した。

• 調整後フリーキャッシュフローは１４２億ドルで、前年同期の２倍の水準となった。

• 同社は第３・四半期に３５億ドルの配当金を支払い、２５億ドル相当の自社株買いを行った。

• 第３・四半期末の純負債は２０７億ドルで、２０２５年末の３４５億ドルから減少した。

[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領はブラジル大統領選で敗北したフラビオ・ボルソナロ氏が自身こそブラジルの正当な指導者だとしている主張を支持する予定はないと、米当局者を含む関係筋２人が２９日に明らかにした。

長年にわたりボルソナロ氏と同氏の父親を支援してきたトランプ氏は、現職のルラ大統領が勝利したブラジルの大統領選決選投票について、不正が行われたように見えると述べたものの、この選挙で特定の候補者を支持したことはないと強調。また、ルラ氏とは良好な関係にあるとも述べた。

匿名を条件に取材に応じた米当局者と事情に詳しい関係者によると、ボルソナロ氏の米国入国は許可されたものの、トランプ氏は現時点ではボルソナロ氏の政治的野望を支援する計画はない。ただ、トランプ氏が考えを変える可能性もあるという。

ホワイトハウスはコメント要請を国務省に回したが、同省からの回答はなかった。ブラジル政府およびボルソナロ氏の代理人もコメント要請に応じなかった。
